title: China Donates Computer Equipment to Tanzania's Ministry of Home Affairs
description: On 5 September of 2009, the Chinese Ministry of Public Security made another computer donation to the Tanzanian Ministry of Home Affairs. Worth about 1.5 million CNY, the donation included 150 personal computers, 50 notebook computers, 30 scanners, and 40 digital cameras. The donation was haded to Tanzanian Minister of Home Affairs Lawrence Masha.

title: Chinese Embassy donates XAF 164.5 million worth of anti-epidemic kits to Cameroon Defense Ministry in June 2020
description: On June 15, 2020, the Chinese Ambassador to Cameroon, Wang Yingwu, handed over a donation of anti-epidemic kits worth XAF 164.5 million to the Cameroon Ministry of Defense. The kits included 50,000 regular masks, 6,000 surgical masks, 4,200 protective glasses, and various other anti-epidemic materials for disinfection and patient services.

receiving_agency: North Macedonia Ministry of National Defense
title: Chinese Ministry of Defense provides protective medical equipment worth 250,000 euros to North Macedonian army in July 2020
description: On July 14, 2020, the Chinese Ministry of National Defense provided protective medical equipment to the North Macedonian army. The donated equipment included 62,000 protective masks, 4,200 protective glasses, 3,000 visors, 6,000 protective suits and sets, gloves, infusion pumps, electric thermometers, and 2 sets of thermal helmets. The monetary value of this donation is an estimated 250,611 euros. A handover ceremony was held for this donation. The State Secretary of the Ministry, Dragan Nikolic, and China’s Ambassador to North Macedonia, Zhang Zuo, attended the ceremony and delivered speeche

title: Chinese Government provides EUR 150,000 grant for the provision of ultrasound devices
description: On August 20, 2009, the Chinese Government provided an EUR 150,000 grant to the Government of Serbia for the procurement of ultrasound devices for Serbia's Military Medical Academy (Ministry of Defense), pursuant to a prior ETCA.

title: Chinese Government provides $305,810 in grant assistance for drug trafficking seminars in Xinjiang
description: In 2011, the Chinese Government provided grant assistance worth $305,810 to Tajikistan for seminars, as reported by the May 2018 Flat Export from Tajikistan AIMS. The AIMS Record ID is TJK/112259.

title: Chinese Government donates forensic equipment worth RMB 1 million
description: In November 2002, China's Ministry of Public Security committed a donation of forensic laboratory equipment worth 1 million RMB to their Uzbek counterparts. The current state of this project is unknown. According to Chinese source, the contract is signed in 2001._x000D_ _x000D_

title: China's Public Security Ministry donates 1million yuan worth equipment to Kazakh police
description: On February 19, 2003 China's Public Security Ministry donated police equipment to the Kazakh Interior Ministry in Almaty. The total cost was 1mil yuan. The police equipment and technology supplied by China includes night vision devices, metal detectors, microscopes, tape recorders, computers, scanners, printers, photo equipment, telephones and flashlights. The agreement on the supply of special equipment by the Chinese Public Security Ministry as technical no-strings aid to the Kazakh Interior Ministry was signed by the sides in Beijing on November 18, 2002.

title: Embassy of China in Myanmar donates emergency police equipment worth $267,968.62 to Myanmar Ministry of Home Affairs in 2019
description: On January 24, 2019, China decided to grant Myanmar's Home Affairs Police equipment worth of $267,968.62. On April 6, 2019, the equipment arrived at the Port of Naypyidaw. On May 13, 2019, according to the news release from the Embassy of China in Myanmar, the Embassy handed the equipment over. The aid was intended to help the Myanmar police maintain peace and stability in the context of the Rakhine State issue. The handover ceremony was held in Nay Pyi Taw, and the Chinese Ambassador to Myanmar Hong Liang and Myanmar Home Affairs Minister Kyaw Rui delivered speeches.

title: China Ministry of Public Security donates security materials for Madagascar Police Material Purchase Project
description: On February 28, 2018, the Chinese Ambassador to Madagascar, Yang Xiaorong, took part in a signing ceremony for an Exchange of Letters Agreement with the Madagascar Ministry of Security. The letters specified that China's Ministry of Security would donate a batch of crime fighting materials to the Madagascar Ministry of Public Security. This agreement is seen as a way to strengthen diplomatic ties between China and Madagascar. This project is part of a continued investment on China's part in Madagascar's domestic security forces. On July 25, 2019, the Government Procurement Office under the C

title: PLA provides $500,000 grant for Taurama Military Hospital Upgrading Project (Linked to Project ID#42165)
description: On July 8, 2005, Papua New Guinea Defence Force and the People's Liberation Army (PLA) of China signed a protocol agreement, which committed PGK 1.5 million of grant funding to the Taurama Military Hospital Upgrading Project. Then, in May 2008, the PLA of China provided an additional $400,000 grant for the Taurama Military Hospital Upgrading Project. At some point during 2008, the PLA of China also provided an additional $100,000 for the Taurama Military Hospital Upgrading Project. Project ID#42165 captures the PGK 1.5 million grant that was provided in 2005. This project, ID#42128, captures

title: Chinese Government donates security supplies worth FCFA 156 million to the Central African Republic
description: On January 22, 2021, the Chinese Government donated defense and security supplies worth FCFA 156 million to the Central African Republic. The donation includes an unknown quantity of computer equipment, handcuffs, and police uniforms. The equipment will be used by the Central African Republic's Defense and Security Forces.

title: Chinese Government donates $250,000 USD in medical equipment as part of Action Brilliant campaign (linked to #60024)
description: On June 6, 2018, a Memorandum of Understanding was signed between Chinese Ambassador to Madagascar Yang Xiaorong, and Madagascar's Minister of Public Health, Lalatiana Andriamanarivo, in which the Chinese Government agreed to a donation of $250,000 USD in medical equipment to the Malagasy Ministry of Public Health. The equipment was handed over on the same day. This donation was part of the 2 week long "Action Brilliant" campaign that began in Antananarivo on May 31st, 2018 to offer free cataract treatment in the country. The equipment will be left in the Joseph Ravoahangy Andrianavalona Hosp

title: Chinese government provides grant of police supplies worth VUV 34.43 million to Vanuatu (linked to Record ID#104566, 104568)
description: On August 25, 2023, the Chinese Ambassador to Vanuatu Li Minggang attended the handover ceremony of a batch of police supplies (worth VUV 34.43 million) to improve the law enforcement conditions of the Vanuatu Police Force. The Ambassador also attended the launch ceremony for the first Chinese police expert group sent to Vanuatu (see Record ID #104566) The batch of supplies included 1,036 sets of operational suits and fast-dry operational suits, 1,036 sets of training T-shirts, 748 pairs of tactical gloves, 70 sets of tactical belts, handcuffs, police flashlights, and police batons, as well a

title: China provides 140,000 USD to Afghanistan Police
description: From April 1, 2007 to December 31, 2008, China provides 140,000 USD assistance to the Afghanistan Police._x000D_ _x000D_

title: Chinese Government provides security equipment to Malawi police force in April 2021
description: On April 29, 2021, the Chinese Government donated security equipment to the Malawi police force. The equipment included 300 tents, bullet proof vests, handcuffs, gas masks, shields, helmets, shock baton sticks and binoculars. The donation has a monetary value of MK200 million ($250,000 USD). A handover ceremony was held for this donation in Lilongwe, the capital of Malawi. Malawi’s Minister of Homeland Security, Richard Chimwendo Banda, and China’s Ambassador to Malawi, Liu Hongyang, attended the ceremony.

title: Chinese Government donates police uniforms worth $110,000 to Timor-Leste’s Ministry of Home Affairs
description: According to Timor Leste's 2006-07 General Budget of the State, the funding for the China's donation of police uniforms amounted to 111,000 USD. On September 8, 2005, the handover ceremony for the Chinese donation of police supplies and communications equipment to Timor-Leste was held at the Ministry of Home Affairs [内政部]. Chinese Ambassador to Timor-Leste Chen Duqing and Minister of Home Affairs Rogerio Lobato [罗热里奥·洛巴托] handed over the police supplies and communications equipment from the Chinese Ministry of Public Security, and both signed the transfer certificate.

title: China donates newly constructed K188 million Nsipe Police Post to Malawi in May 2021
description: On May 18, 2021, the Chinese government donated a newly constructed Nsipe Police Post to the Government of Malawi. The Nsipe Police Post, located in the Ntcheu District, will be used to assist Malawi in its reduction of road accidents and crime. It will serve a population of about 80 thousand Malawian people from Traditional Authorities Kwataine, Makwangwala, and Champiti. The Nsipe Police Post is worth K188 million. The donation occurred at a handover ceremony, where Chinese Ambassador to Malawi Liu Hongyang and Malawi Vice President Saulos Chilima were in attendance. In addition to the Nsi

title: The Chinese Embassy donated 50 electric motorcycles worth PHP 9452k to the Manila Police District in 2019
description: On Jan 28, 2019, a handover ceremony was held at the Manila Police District (MPD) headquarters for the donation of 50 electric motorcycles from the Chinese Embassy in Manila. According to the Philippine News Agency, the donation was worth approximately PHP 9,452,700.

title: China donates forensic equipment to Cambodian police
description: According to a media report on October 23, 2001, China gave Cambodia a gift of forensic equipment worth 80,000 dollars. This donation included materials that would enable Cambodian authorities to find clues from fingerprints and blood. This donation would provide the Cambodian police with forensic investigation capabilities, where previously, the authorities have to rely on forensic specialists from neighboring Thailand and Vietnam or did not use forensic investigation techniques at all.

title: Chinese government provides second batch of police supplies worth VUV 27 million to Vanuatu (linked to Record ID#104566, 104567)
description: On November 21, 2023, the Chinese government donated a second batch of police supplies (worth VUV 27 million) to Vanuatu, which included electronic data forensics laboratory equipment. The grant also included a 16-seater bus, a boxing ring, boxing gloves, punchbags, and fighting gear for the Vanuatu Police Force. (Linked to Record ID #104567).

title: Chinese pathologist team provides technical assistance in autopsies to Samoan Ministry of Health
description: On April 29, 2021, a team of 8 Chinese forensic pathologists arrived in Apia Samoa to assist in the post-mortem examination of a backlog of 13 bodies that have been stored in the morgue for almost 1 year awaiting autopsies. The Chinese government provided the equipment for the post-mortem examination and also covered all the expenses including the autopsy, traveling, and accommodation of the Chinese forensic pathologist team, costing more than 500,000 Tala. At the additional request of the Samoan government, the Chinese forensic pathologist team also conducted 3 more autopsies of current ca

title: ZTE donation of radio equipment to Mauritius Police Force
description: ZTE Corporation China donated two B.T.S. radio sets (Model ZXC10) worth Rs. 4,960,000 to the Mauritius Police Department, specifically the Communications Branch. The date of donation is listed as April 5 2012.

title: Chinese Government grants RMB 700,000 for the provision of police equipment
description: On November 26, 2004, Chinese Government signed an RMB 700,000 grant for the provision of police equipment. Under the agreement between the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Uzbekistan and the Ministry of Public Security of the People’s Republic of China, the Chinese government granted 700,000 RMB to the Ministry of the Internal Affairs of the Republic of Uzbekistan.

title: China grants $211,781 USD to Liberia National Police for Ebola response (Linked to Record ID#41547, #45060)
description: In 2014, China committed to various sectors of the Government of Liberia over 3 million dollars to fight Ebola. During the signing ceremony, the PRC Government is providing US$1 million cash to the Liberian Government (see #41547); US $2 million to the World Food Programme (WFP) (see #45060), and US $211,781 logistical support to the LNP. This project captures the donation to the LNP, which includes vehicles, motorcycles, communication equipment, among others. Other Ebola-related assistance provided by the Chinese Government in 2014 is captured in umbrella Record ID#60642.

title: China's Ministry of National Defense donates medical equipment to Sri Lanka's Ministry of Defence
description: On May 12, 2020, China's Ministry of National Defense donated 70,000 disposable medical masks, 9,000 surgical masks, 9,000 medical surgical masks (KN95), 6,300 medical protective goggles, 4,500 disposable medical protective screens (face shields), 4,500 disposable one-piece medical protective suits, 4,500 disposable medical isolation (170) gowns, 9,000 pairs of disposable medical boot covers, 80 disposable medical gloves, 160 disposable nitrile gloves 50-packets, 30 infusion pumps, two 16-litere Knapsack disinfectant sprayers (16L), 70 frontal temperature gun CK - T1501 (IR thermometers) and

title: China provides $150,000 worth of office and communication equipment to CTSAMM, South Sudan (linked to #53322)
description: On April 28th, 2016, the Chinese government provided $150,000 worth of office and communication equipment to the South Sudan Ceasefire and Transitional Security Arrangements Monitoring Mechanism (CTSAMM) at the CTSAMM headquarters in Juba. This grant is intended to ease the peace negotiation process in South Sudan._x000D_ _x000D_ This project is one of the two grants to CTSAMM made in the same event. The other one is a $550,000 cash grant, which is reported in #53322.

title: Chinese Government grants 131,652 euros to Albania for Non-traditional Security Threats Seminar
description: In 2017, the Chinese Government granted 131,652 euros for a Seminar on Non-traditional Security Threats for Albania in Hangzhou, China. Seminar participants were from the State Police & Ministry of Interior. This project started on May 4, 2017 and reached completion on May 24, 2017. The seminar was to teach the State Police & Ministry of Interior on how to handle security threats, organized crime, terrorism, and trafficking.

title: China offers technical assistance to Kyrgyz's Border Service
description: In 2017, China's Ministry of Public Security agreed to provide technical assistance worth 1 million yuan to the Kyrgyz Border Service. This agreement was signed in context of strengthening cooperation between the two countries in the fields of counter-terrorism and personnel support. China additionally proposed training cooperation between Chinese and Kyrgyz personnel.

title: China Commits to Give Uniforms worth US$150,000 to Uzbekistan's Police
description: In February 2015, the Ministry of Public Security of China signed an agreement to provide uniforms (summer and winter clothing) to Uzbekistan's Ministry of Internal Affairs' policemen for a total amount of USD$150,000.

title: Chinese Government donates communications equipment worth $75,000 to Timor-Leste’s Ministry of Home Affairs
description: On September 8, 2005, the handover ceremony for the Chinese donation of police supplies and communications equipment to Timor-Leste was held at the Ministry of Home Affairs (援助东帝汶内政部警用物资). Chinese Ambassador to Timor-Leste Chen Duqing and Minister of Home Affairs Rogerio Lobato [罗热里奥·洛巴托] handed over the police supplies (captured in #64675) and communications equipment from the Chinese Ministry of Public Security, and both signed the transfer certificate. According to Timor Leste's 2006-07 General Budget of the State, the funding for the communications equipment amounted to 75,000 USD.

title: Chinese People's Liberation Army donates anti-epidemic materials in June 2020 to Zimbabwe National Defense Forces
description: On June 4, 2020, anti-epidemic materials provided by the Chinese People's Liberation Army to the Zimbabwe National Defense Forces arrived at the Harareman Air Base in Zimbabwe. The materials included 62,000 masks, 19,000 pieces of personal protection equipment, and other critical medical supplies. China’s Ambassador to Zimbabwe, Guo Shaochun, the Minister of Defense and Veterans Affairs of Zimbabwe, and the Commander of the National Defense Forces attended the handover ceremony.

title: Chinese Government provides fingerprint image-only matching lab worth USD $147,574.37 to Fiji police force
description: In January of 2021, the Chinese Government donated a fingerprint image-only matching lab to the Fiji police. This donation is worth USD $147,574.37. The specific use of this donation is unspecified and requires more investigation.

title: Chinese Government donates computers, printers, and rain coats to the Zambian Police Service
description: In 2003, the Chinese Government donated 10 computers, 10 printers, and 1,000 rain coats worth more than $60,000 USD to the Zambian Police Service.

title: None
description: In June 2010, the China State Construction Engineering Corporation (CSCEC) reduced the amount owed by the Salvation Army of Barbados by 100,000 USD. _x000D_ _x000D_ Between February 2005 and November 2006, CSCEC constructed a new accommodation building and restaurant project for the charitable organization. The opening ceremony for the project took place in December 2006. The project cost a total of 350,000 USD, owed to the CSCEC, but the Salvation Army struggled to pay the full amount. In July 2010, the contractor decided to reduce the amount owed as a contribution to the charity. For forgivi

receiving_agency: Lesotho Ministry of Police and Public Safety
title: China's Ministry of Public Security Donates 30 Motorbikes to Lesotho's Ministry of Police and Public Safety September 2020
description: On September 10, 2020, the Chinese Ministry of Public Security donated 30 motorbikes to Lesotho's Ministry of Police and Public Safety. These bikes were estimated to be worth 2 million loti. They all had a logo that said "China Aid" on them. At the handover ceremony, Chinese Ambassador to Lesotho Lei Kezhong stated that the motorbikes were donated to strengthen safety and law enforcement in Lesotho.

title: Chinese government donates CVE 15 million worth of forensic equipment to Cabo Verde Judicial Police, September 2023
description: On September 6, 2023, the Chinese ambassador in Cabo Verde held a handover ceremony of a batch of forensic equipment for the Cabo Verde Judicial Police (Polícia Judiciária). This donation included computer equipment for the digital forensic laboratory that was worth CVE 15 million.

title: The Chinese Consulate General in Kuching donates 380,000 masks to various sectors of the Sarawak government (linked to project ID #96940, #96941)
description: In June 2021, the Chinese Consulate General in Kuching donated 380,000 masks to various sectors of the Sarawak government, including the Kuching Airport Immigration Bureau, Police Station, Fire and Rescue Bureau, charity organizations and other sectors of Sarawak. The staff of the Consulate General donated the masks directly. This was part of a series of donations to various entities in Sarawak State, Malaysia, in June 2021. Other donations include 99,000 masks (30 boxes) to the Federation of Sarawak Chinese Associations (see project ID #96940) and a donation of 201,000 masks (67 boxes) to t

title: Chinese Government donates 143,000 USD modern fingerprint and forensic science laboratory to Malawi Police Service
description: On July 28, 2023, the Chinese Government provided a 143,000 USD fingerprint testing laboratory to the Malawi Police Service (MPS) in a handover ceremony in Lilongwe, Malawi. The donation will bridge the technological gap in Malawi’s police force.

title: Unspecified Chinese Government Institution grants police supplies worth RMB 1 million to Madagascar
description: In 2021, China and Madagascar signed a cooperation agreement for police supplies. On June 21, 2023, Zhang Wei, Charge d'Affaires of the Chinese Embassy in Madagascar and the Secretary-General of Madagascar's Ministry of Public Security signed a handover certificate for the donation of police supplies. The equipment included including VPN servers, security gateways, network switches, laptops, uninterruptible power supplies, and other electronic equipment. This grant was to help Madagascar's government upgrade the police communication system and upgrade to the "I-24/7" communication system. The

title: Chinese Embassy funds feasibility study for project strengthening ECU 911 through ETCA (linked to #35814)
description: On August 12 and 24, 2015, the governments of China and Ecuador signed and countersigned Letters of Exchange committing 700,000 RMB (or 107,373 USD) to be used for a feasibility study for the "Equipment for the Strengthening of the Integrated Security Service ECU 911 in the Coastal and Rural Areas" project (Dotación de Equipamiento para el Fortalecimiento del Servicio Integrado de Seguridad ECU 911 en el Litoral y Áreas Rurales). The Chinese government agreed to send a team of experts to Ecuador in order to carry out the study. The project was funded through the grant provided in an Economic

title: Chinese Government donates Digital Forensic Laboratory Equipment worth RMB 1 million to Seychelles Police Force, November 2023
description: On November 13, 2023. the Chinese government handed over digital forensic laboratory equipment to the Seychelles police. The laboratory's major functions include data extraction, storage media back-up, quick data acquisition, data analysis and authentication, and data recovery. The equipment is valued at RMB 1 million.

title: China donated PHP 5M to the Philippines for troops injured in Marawi city [September 6th] (linked to #65137)
description: On September 6, 2017, China donated a PHP 5 million check for injured soldiers from Marawi City. Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines Zhao Jianhua turned over the donation to Armed Forces of the Philippines chief of staff Gen in Camp Aguinaldo, Quezon City._x000D_ _x000D_ This project is linked to project #65137, a PHP 65 million donation for wounded troops made on September 13, 2017

title: Beijing Municipal Government provides donation of 10,000 test kits and PPE to San José Municipal Government in November 2020
description: On November 4, 2020, the Chinese Ambassador to Costa Rica handed over a donation from the Beijing Municipal Government to the Municipality of San José. The donation consisted of 10,000 PCR testing kits, as well as an unknown number of protective clothing, isolation glasses, surgical gloves, and thermometers. The testing kits were to be delivered to the Costa Rican Social Security Fund (CCSS), which would in turn use them in clinics in the Central Canton of San José and mass testing in affected areas of the city. The PPE was to be used by front line workers collaborating with the municipal go

receiving_agency: Sao Tome and Principe Ministry of Justice
title: Chinese government provides aid for the reinauguration of the Lembá Tribunal in São Tomé and Príncipe
description: On March 29, 2021, the ceremony of the reinauguration of the Lembá Tribunal was held. The newly renovated building has a court room, offices for judges and judicial police, two cells, and a nursery for minors. According to a Facebook post uploaded by the São Tomé and Príncipe Department of Justice, the renovation of the building cost 1.8 million dobras. The funding for the building was provided by the Government of China.

title: Chinese People's Liberation Army's medical team donated medical equipments worth 0.5M RMB to the Laos 103 Military Hospital. (linked to #65324)
description: From July 25 to August 8, 2017, the Chinese People's Liberation Army dispatched 90 personnels to carry out free medical service in Luang Namtha Province and Vientiane in Laos (or 中国人民解放军 “和平列车—2017”医疗服务队"). During the visit, the team donated more than 2000 pieces of medical equipments including medicines, training protective gear, etc., with a total value of 500000 RMB, to the Laos 103 military hospital._x000D_ _x000D_ It is linked to #65324, the medical support from the team.

title: People's Liberation Army donates medications and medical equipment worth RMB 500,000 (Linked to Project ID#88686 and #88757)
description: In August 2019, the Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) provided medical assistance to Laos under Peace Train-2019 (see linked project ID#88686). As part of the assistance, a PLA medical team traveled to the Hospital of the 5th Division of the Lao People's Armed Forces in Pakse City in the Champasak Province. The team arrived on August 23, 2019. It brought medications and medical equipment worth RMB 500,000, which it was set to donate to Laos after the completion of the medical assistance. Further details are unknown.

title: China donates motorcycles and office equipment worth 37 million CFA in 2015
description: On May 7, 2015, China handed over the donation of motorcycles, LED screens, computers, photocopiers, and fax machines to Togo. Chinse Ambassador to Togo, Liu Yuxi, and the Togolese Minister of Foreign Affairs, Robert Dussey attended the donation ceremony. The equipment was estimated to be worth 37 million CFA and was donated in preparation for the upcoming African Union Summit on Maritime Security and Development.

title: The Chinese Consulate General in Kuching donates 201,000 masks to the Sarawak State Disaster Management Committee in June 2021 (linked to project ID #96940, #96942)
description: In June 2021, the Chinese Consulate General in Kuching donated 201,000 masks to the Sarawak State Disaster Management Committee (a total of 67 boxes) to support medical workers and other front-line anti-epidemic personnel. Minister of Local Government and Housing of Sarawak Dato' Seri Sim Kwai Hsien received supplies on behalf of the Sarawak Disaster Management Committee. This was part of a series of donations to various entities in Sarawak State, Malaysia, in June 2021. Other donations include 99,000 masks (30 boxes) to the Federation of Sarawak Chinese Associations (see project ID #96940)

title: China donates 1000 motocycles to Indonesian police force
description: In September 2003, China donated 1000 Chinese-made motorcycles to the Indonesia police. The motorcycles, which are equipped with sirens and radio receivers, were handed over by Chinese Ambassador to Indonesia Lu Shumin to Police Chief General Da'i Bachtiar. The valuation of the donation was at $1 million.

title: Chinese municipality of Lishui donated medical supplies to Municipality of Santiago and Police in Chile April 2020
description: On April 6th 2020, the Chinese municipality of Lishui donated medical supplies worth an estimated $44,000 to the Municipality of Santiago and Police in Chile. Specifically, Lishui donated 60,000 masks to the Municipality of Santiago. Lishui also donated 40,000 masks and 15,000 pairs of surgical gloves to Police stations in China. The purpose of this donation is to assist Chile in fighting against the pandemic.

title: China National Offshore Oil Corporation provides GYD $10 million grant to Guyana's Civil Defense Commission for flood relief efforts
description: On June 9, 2021, China National Offshore Oil Corporation donated GYD $10 million to the Civil Defense Commission in Guyana. The purpose of this donation was to aid flood relief efforts throughout the country.

title: Chinese Government donates thermometers and face masks to Sri Lanka's Ministry of Defence in April 2020
description: On April 8, 2020, the Chinese Government donated 70 frontal thermometers, 750 medical disposable 20-mask packets (15,000 masks), 2,080 medical disposal 10-mask packets (20,800 masks), 440 medical disposable 50-mask packets (22,000 masks) to Sri Lanka's Ministry of Defence.

title: China donates 1st shipment of anti-epidemic materials to Venezuela in March 2020
description: On March 19, 2020, the first shipment of anti-epidemic materials from China arrived in Venezuela. The shipment included 4,000 early diagnosis test kits, as well as materials used to administer these tests such as biosecurity suits, protective goggles, gloves, and air purifiers to support Venezuelan health care systems. The shipment arrived at Simon Bolivar International Airport in Caracas.

receiving_agency: Trinidad and Tobago Ministry of National Security
title: Chinese government donates natural disaster equipment to National Security Ministry
description: On April 28, 2023, the Chinese government donated 30 emergency tents, 10 standby generators, 5 rescue boats with of engines, fuel containers, and 25 life jackets to Trinidad and Tobago's Office of Disaster Preparedness and Management, a division of the National Security Ministry. The donation was completed at a handover ceremony held on April 28, 2023. Later, in November 2023, the materials were disbursed by the Office of Disaster Preparedness and Management to various government bodies, including the Ministry of Rural Development and Local Government’s Disaster Management Units, the Trinidad

title: Chinese embassy donates 10 motorcycles to Sierra Leone Police Headquarters in 2022
description: On June 14, 2022, the Chinese Embassy in Sierra Leone donated 10 motorcycles to the Sierra Leone Police headquarters. The donation was made to help improve transportation conditions in remote areas. The donation is valued at roughly $43473.12.

title: The Chinese Consulate General in Kuching donates 99,000 masks to the Federation of Sarawak Chinese Associations in June 2021 (linked to project #96941, #96942)
description: In June 2021, the Chinese Consulate General in Kuching donated 99,000 masks, or a total of thirty boxes, to the Federation of Sarawak Chinese Associations. Consul General Cheng Guangzhong led the staff of the Consulate General to donate masks to the Federation of Sarawak Chinese Associations. This was part of a series of donations to various entities in Sarawak State, Malaysia, in June 2021. Other donations include 201,000 masks (67 boxes) to the Sarawak State Disaster Management Committee (see project ID #96941) and a total of 380,000 masks to the Immigration Bureau, Police Station, Fire and

title: People's Liberation Army donates medical protective gear to the South African National Defense Force (SANDF) in November 2020 (linked to project ID#93500 and 93502)
description: On November 27, 2020, the People's Liberation Army donated medical protective gear to the South African National Defense Force (SANDF). The supplies included 30,000 masks, 400 suits, and 500 thermometers. The monetary value of the donation is unknown. The supplies were donated in a handover ceremony where Rear Admiral Bravo Mhlana received the donation on behalf of SANDF. The donation of medical supplies to SANDF was a part of a series of medical supply donations on behalf of the People's Liberation Army of China; previous donations occurred in March 2020 (project ID#93500) and August 2020

title: Chinese Embassy in Malawi donates motorcycles worth K20 million to police
description: On June 16, 2017, the Chinese embassy donated motorcycles to the Malawian police, according to the Chinese Embassy. According to the Malawi Times, 14 motorcycles were donated at a value of K20 million. Around 100 people attended the ceremony, including Ambassador Wang, the Minister of the Interior and Internal Security, Chiumia, The Secretary-General of the State, Madura, and police chief Kachama, among other government officials and police officers.

title: Chinese Embassy in Benin donates 45 motorcycles to the Republican Police of Benin
description: On September 8, 2022, the Chinese Embassy in Benin provided 45 motorbikes to the Republican Police of Benin. The total value of the bikes came in at 20 million West African CFA francs. The purpose of the donation was to ameliorate the operational capacity of the Police. A handover ceremony was held for this donation. Peng Jingtao, China’s Ambassador to Benin, and Sai Yidu, Minister of the Interior and Public Security of Benin, attended the ceremony and delivered speeches. The Secretary-General of the Ministry of Internal Affairs, the main heads of ministries and commissions, and the main head

title: Chinese Government donates printers, laptops, TVs and other equipment valued at Rs. 675,000 to the Mauritius Police Force
description: In 2012, the Chinese Government donated 15 system unit Lenovos, 15 flat panel monitor Lenovos, 10 HP Printers, 5 Lenovo laptops, 2 LCD Hisense TVs and 1 Konika TV to the Mauritius Police Force. These items have an estimated value of 675,000 Rs. The donation was received on June 5, 2012.

title: China Embassy grants two segways to Royal Barbados Police Force
description: On February 28, 2018, the Chinese ambassador to Barbados handed over two segways, valued at BDS$40,000, to the Royal Barbados Police Force (RBPF). The handover occurred at RBPF headquarters, and the Embassy Political Counsellor Zou Xi, Barbadian Chief Inspector Tyrone Griffins as well as all assistant chief inspectors attended the ceremony. The grant is intended to improve the response time of the police force.

title: Chinese government grants 2,560,000 Jamaican dollars to the National Police College of Jamaica to improve Chinese language training classes
description: On 18 November 2018, the Ambassador of the People's Republic of China to Jamaica, Tian Qi, donated 2,560,000 Jamaican dollars to the Chinese language classes at the National Police College of Jamaica (NPCJ). The donation will be used to improve the Chinese language classroom and to attract more police officers to learn Chinese language, culture, and history. The donation follows the 2017 establishment of a Mandarin program at the college.

title: China donates FCFA 10 million worth of Agricultural tools and Office Equipment to Ex-Servicemen and War Victims in Cameroon
description: On April 25th, 2017, Chinese Ambassador to Cameroon handed over agricultural tools and office equipment to Ex-Servicemen and War Victims in Cameroon. This donation was given to Cameroon's Secretary of State in the Ministry of Defense in charge of Ex-Servicemen and War Victims, Koumpa Issa, from the Chinese Ambassador to Cameroon, Wei Wenhua. The materials comprising of cutlasses, hoes, sprayers, watering cans, rain boats, wheel barrows, trucks, dig axe, artisanal oil milling machine, six computers and two printers are worth FCFA 10 million. This project is completed._x000D_ _x000D_

The computers were donated by the Chinese government and received by Police Minister Jimson Sauk in Port Moresby. They included printers, inkjets, diskettes and other computer accessories. Mr Sauk said three of the computers would be used at police headquarters at Konedobu while the other two would be used in the ministry. description: On or about December 1, 2020, the Chinese Embassy in Costa Rica handed over a donation of supplies worth 7.5 million colons to Costa Rica's Ministry of Public Security to be used by police forces in the country, particularly those patrolling the border. More specifically, the donation included 164 pairs of steel-toed rubber boots, a canopy that will serve as a food and meeting center measuring 8x8 meters, 240 units of sunscreen, and 25,000 disposable masks.

description: On January 13, 2017, based on the press release from Embassy of China in Myanmar, the Embassy donates 100 police bicycles and 13 intercoms to the Yangon Provincial Police Department. According to the release from CRI.cn, the value of the donation is about USD 12 thousand._x000D_

receiving_agency: Government of the Province of Jujuy in Argentina
title: Chinese Government provides 10,000 surgical masks to Argentina in June 2020
description: On June 12, 2020, the Chinese government made a donation of 10,000 surgical masks to the Governor of the Jujuy province in Argentina and the Minister of Security. The masks will be dispersed throughout the different sectors in Jujuy that need them the most. The donation was part of the "Jujuy Seguro e Interconectado" (Safe and Interconnected Jujuy) Project.

receiving_agency: Dar es Salaam Special Zone Police
title: Changzhou City Police Bureau Donates Laptops to Tanzanian Police
description: On November 24, 2012, the Police Bureau of Changzhou City donated ten laptops to the Dar es Salaam Special Zone Police for facilitation of combating crime. The donation was worth an estimated 15 million Tanzanian shillings.

receiving_agency: Lesotho Ministry of Police and Public Safety
title: China donates 100,000 M for greenhouse project at the Police Training College in Lesotho
description: On November 27, 2018, the Chinese Ambassador, Mr. Song Changqing, officially handed over a 100,000 M check to the Police Training College (PTC) in Lesotho to assist in a greenhouse project. The project details are unknown. In the same donation ceremony, China also donated community policing kit and resources, including blankets, gumboots and torches, to the Lesotho Ministry of Police and Public Safety (Project ID#55767). Furthermore, China has also agreed to donating a fingerprint examination lab to Lesotho.

receiving_agency: Benguet Police Provincial Office|Benguet Provincial Advisory Group for Police Transformation and Development (BPAGPTD)
title: Chinese Consulate donates PHP 500,000 for the Pailaw Project in La Trinidad, Philippines
description: On June 9, 2023, the Chinese Consulate in Laoag donated PHP 500,000 to the Benguet Police Provincial Office in the Philippines for the Pailaw Project. The project is run by the Provincial Advisory Group for Police Transformation and Development (PAGPTD). The purpose of the project is to provide local residents with electricity for their homes. The donation ceremony was held at the Benguet Provincial Capitol Hall in La Trinidad, Philippines.

title: Chinese government provides masks to Mayor's Office of Panama City in April 2020
description: On April 8, 2020, the Chinese government donated 10,000 masks to the Mayor’s Office of Panama City. These masks will be utilized by staff and working personnel of the office. They will be distributed among collaborators of the Municipality of Panama, the Houses of Peace, and the Municipal Police. The monetary value of this donation is unknown. Mayor José Luis Fábrega accepted this donation which was handed over by the Chinese Embassy.

title: Chinese Embassy in Sri Lanka donates materials valued 1.5 million rupees to the Seva Vanitha Unit of the Sri Lanka Air Force in November 2021
description: On November 12, 2021, the Embassy of China made a donation of over Rs. 1.5 million to the Seva Vanitha Unit of the Sri Lanka Air Force. This was delivered by the Chinese delegation led by the Defence Attache of the Chinese Embassy in Sri Lanka, Senior Colonel Wan Dong. The purpose of this donation is to continue the dedicated work by the SLAF Seva Vanitha Unit to uplift the living standards of families of service and civilian personnel who are in need through welfare projects in the year 2022.

The donation includes 200 jackets and 2 computers. The total value of the donation is estimated to be NAD 32000. This donation is expected to help police in the Khomas region accomplish crime prevention initiatives. The donation was handed over at the police headquarters in Windhoek.

title: Chinese Government donates masks, coveralls, disinfectant cans, and helmets with face shields to Sri Lanka's Ministry of Defence in April 2020
description: On April 10, 2020, the Chinese Government donated 50 medical disposable mask 50-packets (2,500 masks), 100 special coveralls, six liquid disinfectant 4-liter cans, and six helmets with face shields to Sri Lanka's Ministry of Defence.

title: Chinese Embassy provides anti-epidemic materials to the Chad National Police Department in June 2020
description: On June 26, 2020, the Chinese Embassy provided anti-epidemic materials to the National Police Department of Chad. The donated materials consisted of 5,000 medical masks. These materials were raised by the Chinese Embassy in Chad. The monetary value of this donation is unknown. A handover ceremony was held at the National Police Headquarters of Chad. Secretary Yusuf and other officials attended the meeting.

description: On August 21, 2019, Chinese ambassador Song Yumin formally presented a gift of 200 motorcycles to the Trinidad and Tobago Police Service (TTPS) at the Policy Academy in St. James, Port of Spain. The donation was originally announced on May 14, 2019. The motorcycles are equipped with GPS and camera technology, and the Prime Minister hopes that they will reduce the response time of the TTPS and give citizens a greater sense of security.

China’s Ambassador to Togo, Chao Weidong, the Executive Secretary of the Alliance Party, the Vice Chairman, and representatives of women's movement members attended the ceremony.

title: China donates anti-malaria medication to Togo in 2017
description: On December 8th, 2017, a handover ceremony was held for the donation of antimalarial medication to the Ministry of Health and Social Security of Togo by the Chinese Ambassador to Togo._x000D_ _x000D_ According to a deputy dean in charge of the Lomé Regional Central Hospital in Togo, artemisinin is the first choice for the treatment of malaria in the hospital. Every year, the Chinese government assists Togo with artesunate antimalarial drugs and conducts malaria treatment and training and guidance for local medical staff.

title: Chinese Embassy donates detention center to Dili Police
description: In April 2021, The Timor-Leste government requested help from the Chinese Embassy to construct a detention center. Construction took more than 6 months to complete. On December 17th, 2021, construction was complete and the Chinese Embassy handed over the center to National Police.

title: Chinese Government donates motorcycles and air conditioners to Lagos Police
description: On November 9, 2017, the Chinese consulate in Lagos donated supplies to the police in Lagos. The donation include nine motorcycles and nine split floor type room air conditioners.

The training was undertaken in China by the Yunnan Police Officers College. A total of 20 Timorese police officers attended the 15 days of training. The opening ceremony of the training was held at the Yunnan Police Officers College on September 3, 2018.

title: China donates uniforms to Timor-Leste National Police in 2019
description: On December 13, 2019, the handover ceremony of police uniforms from China for the Timor-Leste National Police was held at the Timor-Leste National Police Headquarters. Chinese Ambassador to Timor-Leste Xiao Jianguo and Minister of the Interior Filomeno da Paixão de Jesus signed the handover certificates on behalf of the countries.

title: China donates security equipment to Timorese National Police in 2018
description: On March 14, 2018, a ceremony was held at the Timor-Leste National Police Headquarters for the donation of security equipment from China to the Timor-Leste National Police. The donation included multi-functional command and control systems, digital trunking communication systems, explosives removal suits and alcohol testers, and other items. Chinese Ambassador to Timor-Leste, Liu Hongyang, and East Timorese Minister of Defense and Security, Somochu, signed the handover certificate on behalf of the two governments. The monetary value of the donation is unknown.

The project was implemented by Shandong Foreign Economic and Technical Corporation (中国山东对外经济技术合作集团有限公司). The project will reportedly address water shortage issues for personnel stationed at the barracks and nearby residents. Signing and construction start dates are unknown.

description: On August 14th, 2019, the handover ceremony of logistics materials occurred at the Timor-Leste Defense Force, FDTL (Falintil-Forcas de Defesa de Timor-L'este) headquarters. The FDTL headquarter was built with Chinese aid in 2010 (see project #38001). Ambassador Xiao Jianguo of China attended the ceremony, emphasizing that the provided logistics materials will improve the self-sustaining capability of the F-FDTL and improve the living conditions of military officers/soldiers. The handover certificate was signed by Ambassador Xiao and Minister Filomeno.

title: 16th Chinese Deployment of Police Forces in Timor-Leste
description: On May 11, 2011, China sent its 16th deployment of peacekeeping forces to Timor Leste. This squad comprised of 23 members from the Department of Public Safety of Fujian Province. Member had received training from the Chinese Peacekeeping Police Training Center in topics such as situation identification, international law and peacekeeping behaviors. They will replace the 15th deployment from Shandong Province and will complete a year long mission in Timor Leste with the United Nations. The 16th batch of Chinese peacekeepers would return to China at the end of 2012.

title: Chinese Embassy in Pakistan donates office supplies to the Pakistani capital police department

description: On May 16, 2012, China deployed its 17th batch of police officers to Timor-Leste to support the UN peacekeeping operation in the country. The team comprised of 13 officers from the Chinese province of Heilongjiang and would be staying for six months to support law enforcement efforts in Timor-Leste. The team formally began their work on May 22, 2012 and returned to China November of the same year. Prior to their tenure, the team underwent nine months of training in preparation for their mission.

title: 15th Chinese Deployment of Peacekeeping Police Timor-Leste
description: China sent its 15th deployment of peacekeeping police officers to Timor-Leste May 11, 2010. The team comprised of 24 members from the province of Shandong with backgrounds in criminal investigation, public security, and traffic control. Like previous teams, the Chinese police officers will be working with the UN mission in Timor-Leste to help stabilize the country. Eight out of the 24 police personnel had previously participated in United Nations peacekeeping missions.

title: Chinese Embassy in Uganda donated office supplies to Uganda International Police Organization
description: On December 30, 2014 the Chinese Ambassador to Uganda Zhao Yali donated office supplies to the Uganda International Police Organization. The total cost of the donation is unclear.

title: Chinese Embassy in Uganda funded the construction of Uganda Police Department kindergarten project

The China-Uganda Friendship Kindergarten was constructed by the Tian Tang Group and donated by the Chinese Embassy to the Uganda Police Force. The center will cater to Police Officers’ children who stay and work within Kampala. The total cost of this project is unclear.

The donation includes CT baggage scanners, mobile x-ray system from Nuctech and is delivered by CCOEC. The equipment is to be used to improve border security, detection and seizure of illicit drugs, and prevent smuggling into Vanuatu.

In August 2013, China was to select the top twenty teachers from the local school to travel to China and enhance their skills in Wushu martial arts. title: Chinese Government donates 180 solar water heaters to Zimbabwe Republic Police (ZRP) in 2006
description: On August 24, 2006, the Chinese Government donated 180 solar water heaters to the Zimbabwe Republic Police as part of a project to introduce China's experience and technology in solar energy development to the solar energy-rich country. The goal of this project was to evaluate the performance of the Chinese-made solar heaters under local conditions, to train local technicians in installation and maintenance, to demonstrate the green energy technology, and to promote commercial and industrial cooperation in green energy. description: On May 22, 2014, China’s Ministry of Commerce sent a team to assist in the design and training of a choreography team for Zambia’s 50th Independence Day celebration (or “Golden Jubilee Celebration”) on October 24, 2014. At the request of Zambian Government, the China’s Ministry of Defense and the Chinese Armed Police also dispatched 7 instructors to train 500 members of the Zambia National Service for the much-anticipated independence celebration.

title: 18th military medical team dispatched to Zambia
description: China has been sending military medical teams to Zambia since 1984. On January 20, 2015, China’s 18th military medical team arrived in Zambia. The 11-person team was stationed at Maina Soko Hospital in Lusaka and completed its term of service on January 18, 2016. The members of the team undertook outpatient service, consultation, operation, guidance and teaching activities at Maina Soko military hospital. They also provided medical care for the President and the First Lady, and treated hundreds of senior officials and officers from both Zambian government and military.

title: Chinese Embassy Establishes Sino-Vietnamese Cultural Reading Room and Donates Books to the Police Academy
description: On January 1, 2021, a ribbon-cutting ceremony was held for the new Sino-Vietnamese Cultural Reading Room of the Police Academy of the Ministry of Public Security of Vietnam. On behalf of the embassy, Counselor Yin Haihong also donated Chinese language books including "Xi Jinping on Governing the Country" to the reading room.

description: On November 3, 2020, the Chinese Embassy in Vietnam assisted the Foreign Affairs Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security of Vietnam by providing a reading room and Chinese language book corner. A ribbon-cutting ceremony for the reading room was held on November 3, 2020. Minister Counselor Yin Haihong was invited to attend and cut the ribbon with Lieutenant General Nguyen Thanh Son, Director of the Vietnam Foreign Affairs Bureau. Major General Jian Ling, the deputy director of the Foreign Affairs Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security of Vietnam, received disposable medical masks, goggles, and protective clothing.

Military officer Wang Jinbo and the director of the Military Medical Bureau of the National Defense Command jointly signed the transfer documents. The batch of medical equipment includes ambulances, digital X-ray machines, and mobile dental clinics.

description: On March 27, 2007, China sent a group of 10 civilian police officers to Timor-Leste to help the country stabilize following its crisis in May 2006. They were accompanied by three military observers from the UN mission in Timor-Leste (UNMIT). The officers are specialists in the fields of administrative management, information technology, public security, criminal investigation and border security. title: China government donates Military Band Music Equipment to Vanuatu
description: On January 13th, 2016, the Chinese Ambassador, Xie Bohua, a ceremony was held for the donation of musical instruments to the Vanuatu Mobile Force (VMF) (or 捐赠瓦机动部队乐器). The VMF is the paramilitary arm of the country's police force. The ceremony was also attended by 30 officers and soldiers, including the Mobile Band Commander. These instruments are intended to help the Vanuatu Mobile Forces military band renew and upgrade their instruments, and help the military band to better rehearse and perform for major events.

description: Based on the news release from the Embassy of China in Myanmar, on May 2, 2017, the Embassy provides a Chinese language training course for the Myanmar Police Force. The opening ceremony was held in the headquarters building of the Myanmar Police Force in Naypyidaw. This training course is the fourth Chinese language training course for Burmese civil servants organized by the Chinese Embassy in Myanmar at the request of the Myanmar Police Force._x000D_ _x000D_ _x000D_ _x000D_

title: Chinese Army provides medical training and service through the ‘Peace Ark’ Naval Hospital Ship to Vanuatu
description: On August 31st, 2014, the Chinese Navy Ship, Peace Ark, arrived in Vanuatu to provide medical services. The ship served as the main platform for free-of-charge medical services, including "outpatient and surgical treatment" (according to "驻瓦努阿图大使谢波华在中国海军和平方舟医院船甲板招待会上的致辞"). The Chinese press release, "驻瓦努阿图大使谢波华陪同瓦总理参观和平方舟医院船", stated that the boat has received a total of 7,512 outpatients, completed 58 operations, admitted 26 inpatients, carried out 3382 CT and X-ray auxiliary examinations, and conducted comprehensive medical examinations for 33 people. description: During Vanuatu Prime Minister Serge Vohor's visit to China from September 5 to 12, 2004, China and Vanuatu signed an initial agreement that would provide equipment and training for the Vanuatu police force, following a request from the Vanuatu Minister of Public Utilities. Members of the police force will undergo training in China, particularly in anti-terrorism warfare and bodyguard and self-defense skills. Details regarding the agreement and further project details are unknown.

title: Chinese Government agrees to send a team to train the Ugandan police in December 2017
description: On December 20, 2017, during a meeting between the Inspector General of Police, Kale Kayihura, and a delegation of the China Public Security, the Chinese Government agreed to send a team to Uganda to train the Uganda police in areas of criminal investigations, crime intelligence, and cybercrime. The decision was made after two Chinese nationals were murdered in Uganda.

description: In 2018, the Chinese Embassy funded a Chinese training course for staff in the Ministry of Hotels and Tourism and its police force in Myanmar. A total of 21 people attended the course, which was taught by Eastern Language & Business Center in Yangon. On October 5, 2018, the closing ceremony of the training course was held in Yangon. Tian Shanting, the Cultural Counselor of the Chinese Embassy in Myanmar, and Wu Ne Win, the Director of the Department of Hotel and Tourism Supervision, attended the closing ceremony and delivered speeches. The monetary value of the training is uknown.

title: China deploys 14th team of peacekeeping police in Timor-Leste
description: China's 14th peacekeeping squad to Timor Leste arrived in 2009. The 21-person squad was sent to work with the UN mission in East Timor for one year, setting the end date to be in February 2010. Seven out of the 21 members had previously participated in UN peacekeeping missions. The squad, which includes staff from the criminal investigation, public security, traffic and entry and exit sections in the southeastern Jiangxi Province, all passed strict exams in the regional situation, world affairs, international law, driving, first aid, and English.

description: On December 11, 2018, on behalf of the Chinese Government, Chinese Ambassador Ren Yisheng donated office equipment, such as computers and projectors to Police Region 5 of the Royal Thai Police. Region 5 consists of the northern Thai city of Chiang Mai.

title: The Chinese Embassy in Thailand donates masks to Thai government institutions and hospitals
description: On April 5th, 2020, the Embassy of the People's Republic of China in the Kingdom of Thailand donated N95 and disposable masks to the Palace Affairs Office, the National Assembly, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Airport Customs, the Airport Administration, the Airport Immigration Bureau, and various police stations, as well as Ratchaviti Hospital and Sirirat Hospital. On February 23, 2018, they had a final meeting with the Chinese Ambassador to South Sudan before returning to China. The amount of funding China provided to send this force to South Sudan is unknown. The team earned a medal from the United Nations in November 2017. This project is completed.

description: On August 3, 2020, the People's Liberation Army donated masks to the South African National Defense Force (SANDF). The monetary value of the donation is unknown. The gear was meant to be utilized by members of the SANDF and the National Department of Health. The donation of medical supplies to SANDF was a part of a series of medical supply donations on behalf of the People's Liberation Army of China; a previous donation occurred in March 2020 (project ID#93500) and a subsequent donation occurred in November 2020 (project ID#93501).

title: Chinese Embassy donates office equipment to the Royal Papua New Guinea Constabulary
description: On February 23, 2009, the Chinese Embassy in Papua New Guinea donated office equipment to the Royal Papua New Guinea Constabulary (RPNGC). title: Fujian Police College provides anti-crime training to 28 South African officers from the Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department (JMPD)
description: On August 2019, China's Fujian Police College hosted 28 police officers from South Africa's Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department (JMPD) for a free training course in anti-crime activities. The Chinese Government provided a grant to cover the cost of travel and training. It focused on hand-to-hand combat, unarmed defense, firearm use, and Kung Fu tactics. This two-week training course began on August 9, 2019 and ended on August 23, 2019.

description: On October 18, 2018, the Chinese government donated customs scanners and mobile security vehicles to the Papua New Guinea government in preparation for the 2018 APEC meeting. This donation is a part of China's APEC Safety Network Project in Papa New Guinea, which is detailed in Project ID #64683.

title: Chinese Embassy in Pakistan donates electric fans, generators, tents to Pakistani Army stationed in FATA
description: On April 4th, 2018, Chinese Ambassador Yao Jing held a brief ceremony in the museum to hand over donated materials to the Pakistani Army. The Chinese Embassy in Pakistan donated electric fans, generators, tents, and other materials and donated them to the Pakistani military in order to help the Pakistani army improve the working and living conditions of the troops stationed in the Federally Administered Tribal Areas (FATA).

title: China donates office supplies to the Zanzibar Police Station.
description: On October 17, 2019, the ceremony of a donation of office supplies to the Zanzibar Police Station by the Consulate General in Zanzibar was held at the Zanzibar Police Station. The donation included some computers and other office equipment, and was made to improve office conditions and improve work efficiency. The value of the donation is not known.

title: China donates Equipment to Sindh Police
description: On October 11, 2019, officials of the Consulate General of China donated three automobiles, fifty walkie-talkie sets, fifteen printers, two computers, a photocopy machine and a set of monitoring equipment to the Sindh Police during a ceremony at the Sindh Central Police Office. Later, Inspector General of the Sindh Police, Dr. Syed Kaleem Imam, distributed the equipment among different departments. Two mobile vans were given to Foreigners Security Cell while other items were handed over to the Special Security Unit. The donation came 11 months after two police officers from the Sindh Police

title: Chinese Consulate General provides anti-epidemic supplies to the Special Protection Unit of Pakistan’s Punjab Province in May 2020
description: On May 21, 2020, the Chinese Consulate General in Lahore, Long Dingbin, provided a second batch of anti-epidemic materials to the Special Protection Unit (SPU) of Pakistan’s Punjab Province. The specific type and amount of materials donated are unknown. The monetary value of this donation is also unknown. The handover ceremony was held for this donation on May 21, 2020. Consul General Long Dingbin, the Senior Police Superintendent of the Punjab Province, and other police officers attended the ceremony.

title: Chinese Consulate General in Lahore provided police training to a group of security officials from the Punjab Province, Pakistan (Linked to Project #98180)
description: In 2019, the Chinese Consulate General in Lahore organized a group of security officials from the Punjab Province, Pakistan to visit China and take special police training courses.

title: China donates 50 motorcycles to Tanzania Police Force
description: On June 23, 2014, China's Vice Minister of Commerce Li Jinzao attended a ceremony to donate 50 motorcycles to the Tanzania Police Force. This came as part of the "Second China-Tanzania Investment Forum."

title: Chinese Consulate General in Lahore provides materials to the Punjab Province Police Force (Linked to Project #98180)
description: In 2019, the Chinese Consulate General in Lahore donated materials to the Punjab Province Police Force.

title: Chinese Government grant for Moshi Police Academy Expansion Project
description: On March 22, 2017, a Chinese Embassy official signed a project implementation agreement with a Tanzanian Government representative for the Moshi Police Academy Expansion Project. The monetary value of the grant commitment from China’s Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) that support this project is unknown. The Chinese Government originally financed the construction of the Moshi Police Academy back in the 1960s, and the facility was in need of renovation and expansion. The total construction area was 5,500 square meters consisting of 1 office building, 2 teaching buildings, and 4 dormitory building

title: Chinese Embassy donates communications equipment to Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Tajikistan
description: On August 23, 2018, the Chinese Embassy donated communications equipment to the Tajik Ministry of Foreign Affairs. The equipment included communication stations and intercoms to improve working conditions. The donated batch of communication equipment was expected to improve Tajikistan's diplomatic reception capabilities and its security. The value of the donated items is unknown.

title: Chinese Consulate-General in Karachi, Pakistan funds scholarships for Chinese Language Students at Petaro Naval School in Sindh Province
description: On November 13, 2017, the Consul General of Chinese Consulate-General in Karachi, Pakistan, Mr. Wang Yu, awarded scholarships to Chinese-language students studying at the Petaro Naval School in Sindh Province.

title: China-funded Takuriabu Anti-drug Branch office building
description: On March 18, 2016, Yue Bin, the ambassador to Tajikistan, attended the completion handover ceremony of the office building of the China-funded Takuriabu Anti-drug Branch office building. The project was funded by Ministry of Public Security of China and implemented by China Jing'an Import & Export Corporation. The office building aided by the Chinese side is a three-story brick-concrete structure with a construction area of ​​more than 1,000 square meters, including offices, equipment rooms, interrogation rooms, lounges.

title: Chinese Government donates medical equipment to Military Hospital 601
description: On March 22, 2017, the Chinese Embassy in Syria donated 90 wheelchairs and 40 crutches to Military Hospital 601 (المشفى العسكري or المستشفى العسكري "601") in the city of Damascus.

title: China grants 2 police vans to Suriname's Police Department (linked to #56253 and #56507)
description: According to the Chinese Embassy of Suriname, on March 17, 2017, China granted 2 police vans to the KPS (Korps Politie Suriname), the Suriname police department. The goal of this donation is to improve law enforcement and ensure security in Suriname. The value of the two vans is unknown. According to Starnnieuws, in April 2017, four instructors from China arrived to train ten members of the KPS in how to operate the 2 police vans. This information was confirmed via the KPS website, which stated that the training was conducted on April 7th, 2017. China has worked with the KPS in the past and d

title: China donated 30 bulletproof vests to Suriname police headquarters (linked to #56298 and #56507)
description: According to the Chinese Embassy in Suriname, on December 16, 2016, Chinese ambassador Zhang Jinxiong donated 30 bulletproof vests to the KPS (Korps Politie Suriname), the Suriname police department. The vests were received by the police director at the Suriname Police Headquarters. Additionally, the Chinese Embassy assisted in repairing patrol vehicles, offered training for some officers in China to strengthen police law enforcement capabilities (captured in #56507) and donated two police vans (#56298).

title: China grants police materials to Suriname Customs
description: On June 29, 2006, a letter of exchange was signed by Chinese Ambassador Chen Jinghua and Minister of Finance Humphrey Hilton Bach for the Chinese government’s donation of police materials to Suriname Customs. _x000D_ _x000D_ On May 17, 2007, a supply contract was signed. _x000D_ _x000D_ On August 20, 2007, the police materials were handed over to the Suriname customs agency. The materials are intended to assist the Suriname customs agency in preventing illegal smuggling.

title: China donates security and safety equipment to Sudan customs
description: On December 16, 2019, the Chinese Government signed an agreement with the transitional government of Sudan for the donation of security and safety equipment to the Sudan customs. The deal was signed between the Ministry of Finance and Economic Planning of Sudan and the Chinese Government. China also offered personnel training and technical services, to help Sudan crack down upon smuggling, enhance the capacity of customs clearance for both personnel and goods, and safeguard national security. The monetary value of the donation is unknown.

description: On May 10, 2018, the Chinese Ambassador to Sudan Li Lianhe and other Chinese and Sudanese officials attended a ceremony for the donation of agricultural and other production equipment to Sudan. Sudan’s Minister of Defence Aud, Chief of Staff of the Army Abdul Fatah, Undersecretary of the Ministry of Finance Mustafa, Director General of Foreign Financing Omar and Zhou Chunlin, Economic and Commercial Counselor of the Chinese Embassy in Sudan attended the ceremony. The donation was provided to the Popular Defense Forces as part of the Disarming and Demobilization program in rural areas. This pro

title: China sends 435 peacekeepers on UN mission to Sudan in 2005
description: On September 8, 2005, China announced it would send 435 peacekeepers on a UN mission to help rebuild Sudan. The first batch of peacekeepers arrived in Sudan in October 2005. These 435 peacekeepers included a 275-man engineering unit, a 100-man transportation unit, and a 60-man medical unit, all of whom were from the Jinan Military Region. These peacekeepers' main assignment was to aid in the reconstruction of Sudan. It is unknown when this peacekeeping mission ended: however, in 2007 another peacekeeping team was sent to Darfur (recorded in project #2402), and as of 2019 it was reported that

title: Chinese Embassy in Sri Lanka donates 50 bicycles and 3 electric buggies to Sri Lanka Navy (SLN)
description: On December 10, 2019, the Chinese Embassy in Sri Lanka donated 50 bicycles and 3 electric buggies to the Sri Lanka Navy (SLN). The purpose of the donation was to support the SLN's "Green and Blue environment" initiative that seeks to protect and conserve the environment The Deputy Military Naval and Air Attaché of the Embassy of the People’s Republic of China in Sri Lanka, Lieutenant Colonel Chang Qianjin, handed over the bicycles and buggies to Commander of the Navy, Vice Admiral Piyal De Silva during a ceremony on December 10. The Navy intends to use these bicycles and electric vehicles at

title: China Electronic Technology Group Corporation (CETC) donates 149 non-contact digital thermometer guns and 2 non-contact smart access control cameras to Sri Lanka Ministry of Defence in June 2020
description: On June 8, 2020, China Electronic Technology Group Corporation (CETC) donated 149 non-contact digital thermometer guns and 2 non-contact smart access control cameras to Sri Lanka’s Ministry of Defence. The monetary value of this donation is unknown.

title: Chinese Embassy donates motorcycles to Sri Lankan Police Headquarters
description: On December 29, 2021, Ambassador Qi Zhenhong attended the donation ceremony of motorcycles to Sri Lankan Police Headquarters. The number and monetary value of the donated motorcycles is unknown.

title: Chinese Government provides 10 jeeps to Sri Lanka Police
description: On May 8, 2019, the Chinese Government officially donated 10 jeeps to the Sri Lanka Police. The Beijing Automobile Manufacturing Plant produced the vehicles. The monetary value of this donation unknown. Following the Easter Sunday terrorist attacks on April 21, 2019, the Chinese Government provided various donations to the Government of Sri Lanka: 1) 10 police vehicles on May 8, 2019 (Project ID #71784) 2) 100 jeeps worth LKR 1.5 billion on May 14, 2019 (Project ID #91210) 3) LKR 2.6 billion grant on May 14, 2019 (Project ID #88611) 4) X-rays and metal detectors worth LKR 60 million on June

title: China's 'Peace Ark' Naval Hospital Ship Project in PNG
description: On September 11, 2014, the Chinese "Peace Ark" Naval Hospital Ship arrived in Port Moresby Wharf in PNG. The ship's 8-day mission, from September 11th to 18th, focused on supplying Humanitarian Aid medical service to PNG residents. The boat had over 300 crew members. The boat included the eye clinic, laboratory, ultrasound room, disinfectant and supply room, Chinese traditional medicine room, information centre, intensive care unit, operating room and emergency room. title: Chinese Government provides police supplies to Sri Lanka Police
description: On December 5, 2019, the Chinese Government provided police supplies to the Sri Lanka Ministry of National Defense on behalf of the Sri Lanka police. The donation included patrol motorcycles, bicycles, laptops, handheld video recorders, and other unspecified materials. The monetary value of this donation is unknown. Following the Easter Sunday terrorist attacks on April 21, 2019, the Chinese Government provided various donations to the Government of Sri Lanka: 1) 10 police vehicles on May 8, 2019 (Project ID #71784) 2) 100 jeeps worth LKR 1.5 billion on May 14, 2019 (Project ID #91210) 3) LK

title: Chinese Government provides grant to Ceasefire and Transitional Security Arrangements Monitoring and Verification Mechanism
description: On May 10, 2019, the Chinese Government provided a cash donation to Ceasefire and Transitional Security Arrangements Monitoring and Verification Mechanism (CTSAMVM) in South Sudan. This organization monitors compliance by South Sudanese armed groups to the Revitalised Agreement on the Resolution of the Conflict in South Sudan. The monetary value of this donation is unknown.

title: China sends peacekeeping engineers and medics to South Sudan
description: Starting on November 15, 2012, a group of 275 Chinese peacekeeping engineers were scheduled to be deployed to Wau, South Sudan in three batches. These engineers were responsible for the construction and maintenance of roads, bridges and airports in the mission area as well as water supply and power supply facilities. This force was sent from the Jinan Military Region. The mission period for the peacekeepers was 8 months. In addition, the force of Chinese peacekeepers included a separate 63-member medical team. The medical team will be separate from the other group of 275 peacekeepers. The to

title: Chinese Government sends first peacekeeping police force to South Sudan
description: On November 12, 2011, China's first peacekeeping police force in South Sudan departed from China for their one-year mission. The force consisted of 12 officers selected from the Chongqing Police Department. This group would help South Sudan to achieve a smooth transition to independence by assisting the local police in maintaining order, reforming and rebuilding law enforcement agencies, and training the local police. They were scheduled to stay in South Sudan for one year; however, the exact date that they returned to China is unknown. As of January 2020, China has now sent seven peacekeeping

title: Donation of buses to Ministry of Security
description: In 2012, China donated 20 buses to the Ministry of Security to facilitate police and security deployment during the general election. The buses were manufactured by China Auto Caiec Ltd. The buses arrived in Kenya in March, 2012, but were still delayed at the Kenya Ports Authority when they were last reported on in May 2012.

title: China trains 4th batch of Myanmar police in combating drug trafficking
description: Through a bilateral program, China provided in-country drug enforcement training to 35 Myanmar police officers for one month. This was the fourth group from Myanmar to undergo the training program, which began in 2002. The police officers were trained in the Yunnan Police Officer Academy.

title: China and Angola sign letters of exchange for immigration bureau, airport customs, and transportation police training
description: On September 19, 2012, China and Angola signed letters of exchange for three free training courses. The trainings would include training courses for officials of the Angolan Immigration Bureau, training courses for the Angolan airport customs police, and Angola traffic police training courses. All of the courses would be provided free of charge._x000D_ _x000D_ On April 15, 2013, the traffic police training courses began for 20 Angola police officers at Shandong Police Academy. The training was set to last 14 days. The training course for officials of the Angola Immigration Bureau was held in D
