title: People's Liberation Army Military Band performs, provides training in Barbados
description: From August 5 to 18, 2012, twenty members of the Chinese People's Liberation Army Military Band visited Barbados on invitation from the Barbados Defense Force to conduct various performances, engage in business exchanges, and provide training. The visit was part of the celebrations for the 35th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and Barbados, and it was intended to promote cultural exchange and facilitate further friendly relations between the two countries. _x000D_ _x000D_ Throughout the visit, the Chinese band conducted training for the Barbados Defense Force Military Band, th

title: Chinese Embassy in Barbados holds Embassy Open Day for Camp Energy campers
description: On August 21, 2019, the Chinese Embassy in Barbados held an Embassy Open Day for over 80 campers and instructors from Camp Energy. As part of their 2019 "Around the World" theme, campers visited the Embassy and learned about Chinese geography and scenery, history, culture, and traditional customs. The event was intended to increase campers' understanding of Chinese culture and was run by the Barbados Defence Force (BDF). Camp Energy, run specifically by the BDF's Morale, Welfare and Recreation Committee, is for children of either soldiers or civilian employees, age 5 to 14.

title: Chinese military music experts donate musical instruments to the Barbados Defense Force and Cadet Corps (Linked to Project ID#71653)
description: On February 20, 2008, a team of Chinese military music experts arrived for a four-month long training course with the bands of the Barbados Defense Force (BDF) and the Barbados Cadet Corps (BCC) (see linked project ID#71653). During the training course, China donated musical instruments to the BDF and the BCC. These instruments were used in a joint performance by the Barbadian and Chinese groups playing Chinese and Barbadian music during the closing ceremony of the training course on June 19, 2008.

title: Chinese military music experts provide a four-month long training course to the Barbados Defense Force and Cadet Corps (Linked to Project ID#71654)
description: On February 20, 2008, a team of Chinese military music experts arrived in Barbados for a four-month long training course with the bands of the Barbados Defense Force (BDF) and the Barbados Cadet Corps (BCC). During the training, China donated musical instruments to the BDF and the BCC (see linked project ID#71654). The training course was completed on June 19, 2008, with a joint performance by the Barbadian and Chinese groups performing both Chinese and Barbadian music.

title: People's Liberation Army donates musical instruments to the Barbados Defence Force
description: On June 26, 2013, the People's Liberation Army (PLA) donated musical instruments to the Barbados Defence Force (BDF). The donated instruments included saxophones, trumpets, and horns. The donation was intended to assist the BDF's band. The monetary value of this donation is unknown.

title: China donates bullet proof helmets and vests to Bangladesh police
description: On March 22, 2006, China handed over security gear (bullet proof vests and helmets) to the Bangladeshi police as a gesture of friendship. The handover took place between the Chinese Ambassador of Dhaka, Chai Xi, and Bangladesh State Minister for Home Affairs, Lutfozzaman Babar.

title: 16 Argentine police officers attend security training in China in 2019
description: From December 5th to 19th, 2019, 16 police officers from the Argentine Police Department of Córdoba Province attended a security training at a Municipal Police Vocational Training College (市警察职业培训学院) in Jinan, China. The training was organized by the China Ministry of Public Security. A closing ceremony was held two days early, on the 17th.

title: Chinese Government donates Relocatable Military Hospital to the Argentine Army
description: In 2015, China committed to donating a Relocatable Military Hospital (HMR) to the Argentine Army, which was formally donated and received in 2017. The HMR allows for providing surgical and emergency healthcare support for a 48 hour uninterrupted period, performing 2 surgeries simultaneously, hospitalizing 28 patients, and can be easily transported by land, air, and sea in 13x20 foot containers. It serves as an intermediary between outposts of soldiers and permanent military hospitals, intended to diagnose and care for patients during operational deployments.

title: Argentinian Naval personnel attend security training session in China in 2019
description: According to a report from the Government of Argentina's website, from October 10th through 30th, 2019, personnel from the Argentinian Naval Prefecture and other Argentinian security forces attended a training session hosted by Chinese security officials in Hangzhou, China. The objective of the training was the strengthening of cooperation in security matters, the joint fight against international terrorism and organized crime. The training covered the following topics: administration of police resources, international law enforcement cooperation, international terrorism, introduction of organ

title: China Naval Hospital Ship arrives in St. John's port to provide medical assistance in Harmony Mission-2018
description: On October 22, 2018, the Chinese “Peace Ark” naval ship arrived in St. John’s port in Antigua and Barbuda to carry out the “Harmony Mission-2018” or “和谐使命-2018”.” The mission lasted eight days, and the ship departed on October 29th 2018. The Chinese Navy ambulance set up an air health channel between Antigua and Barbuda to care for both islands. During the visit, the Chinese Navy and Ark Hospital ship completed 3924 diagnoses and treatments, 2410 CT, DR and other auxiliary examinations, 53 physical examinations, 16 hospitalizations, and 14 operations.

title: China Eximbank provides a loan for Phase 1 of the Sambizanga Municipal Infrastructure Project (linked to #67304, #67310)
description: In or around 2010, China Eximbank provided a loan to the Government of Angola for Phase 1 of the Sambizanga Municipal Infrastructure Project. The loan terms are unknown. Also in or around 2010, China Development Bank (CDB) provided a buyer’s credit loan (BCL) for Phase 1 of the same project (see #67304). CDB provided an $80 million loan for Phase 2A of this project (see #67310). title: China trains 15 Angola police officers in Jiangsu
description: On July 10, 2016, 15 Angolan police officers departed for China's Jiangsu Police Academy to participate in a 15-day training course. The officers were also scheduled to visit the Jiangsu Provincial Public Security Bureau's Physical Evidence Appraisal Center, Nanjing Public Security Bureau Command Center, Nanjing Confucius Temple Police Station, etc. to learn from China's advanced experience in police work.

title: Chinese Government donates security equipment to Bolivia to safeguard the Plurinational Legislative Assembly's building
description: On July 29, 2004, the Chinese Government and the Government of Bolivia signed an exchange of letters in which the Chinese Government committed to donating security equipment to Bolivia to safeguard the Plurinational Legislative Assembly's building. The exchange of letters came after a bombing in front of the assembly's building in March 2004 killed three Bolivian police officers. The equipment was handed over on July 28, 2005. A monument was erected to commemorate the aid from China. The monetary value of this aid is unknown.

title: China Development Bank provides a buyer's credit loan for Phase 1 of the Sambizanga Municipal Infrastructure Project (linked to #67310, #85374)
description: In 2010, China Development Bank (CDB) and the Government of Angola signed a buyer’s credit loan (BCL) for Phase 1 of the Sambizanga Municipal Infrastructure Project. The face value and borrowing terms of this loan are unknown. China Eximbank also provided a loan for Phase 1 of this project (see #85374). CDB provided an $80 million loan for Phase 2A of this project (see #67310). title: Chinese Embassy to Albania launches the China-Albania Public Management and Administrative Capability Training Project
description: On October 5th, 2018, the Chinese Embassy to Albania held a launching ceremony for the "China-Albania Public Management and Administrative Capability Training Project" . The project promotes human resources development among Albanian participants in the program. During the launching ceremony, the Chinese Ambassador to Albania and Albanian Director-General of the National Resources and Anti-Corruption Departments met with Albanian participants of the program. title: China provides anti-terrorism and anti-drug training to police officers of Afghanistan (Linked to Project ID#37849)
description: On October 28, 2014, China announced that it would hold training on anti-terrorism and anti-drugs for Afghanistan. The announcement was made during Afghan's President Mohammad Ashraf Ghani Ahmadzai visit to China. On the same date the announcement was made, China and Afghanistan signed an agreement on economic and technical cooperation, under which China would provide 2 billion Chinese Yuan in grant (See Project ID#37849). China previously had been providing small-scale security training to Afghanistan, specifically in the form of mine clearance and counter-narcotics training. In January 201

title: China provides training for 300 Afghan police officers
description: On September 23, 2012, China signed an agreement with Afghanistan to provide training to 300 Afghan police officers over the next four years; the officers will be in China for the training. As of 2013, 45 Afghan police officers were receiving training in China on fighting drugs and riots. This number was expected to increase to 250 by 2015. The financial value and current status of this project are unknown.

title: Chinese government sends 1st Chinese police expert group to Vanuatu in 2023 (linked to records 104567, 104568)
description: On August 25, 2023, Chinese Ambassador to Vanuatu Li Minggang attended the launch ceremony for the first Chinese police expert group to Vanuatu to analyze its police capabilities and infrastructure requirements. The same day, the ambassador attended the handover ceremony of a batch of police supplies to improve the law enforcement conditions of the Vanuatu police (see record ID #104567). After arriving in Vanuatu, the expert group assisted the Vanuatu Police Force and offered police capacity training to community-level policing on the islands of Santo and Efate.

title: Chinese government donates communication system equipment to the Scientific and Criminal Investigation Police (PCIC) in Timor-Leste in July 2023
description: On July 25, 2023, the Chinese government donated the I-24/7 Communication System to the Scientific and Criminal Investigation Police (PCIC) in Timor-Leste. The I-24/7 Communication System Equipment is an advanced technological platform that provides critical resources for information sharing and institutional cooperation in the fight against transnational crime. The I-24/7 system will be used by INTERPOL-NCB Díli and the donated equipment strengthens the implementation of this system in Timor-Leste, which promotes security and maintenance of stability by fighting crime in the country.

title: Chinese Consulate General in Chiang Mai donates office equipment to the Fifth Police District in Thailand in March 2023 (Linked to Record ID#107484)
description: On March 8, 2023, the Chinese Consulate General in Chiang Mai donated office equipment to the Royal Thai Police Fifth Provincial Region. The donation was provided to thank the Fifth Police District for its long-term work in protecting the safety of Chinese citizens in northern Thailand and combating transnational crime. The monetary value of the donation is unknown. This is the second donation provided to the Fifth Police District in 2023. The second donation was provided in December 2023 (Record ID 107484).

title: Chinese Consulate General in Chiang Mai donates office equipment to the Fifth Police District in Thailand in December 2023 (Linked to Record ID#107493)
description: On December 19, 2023, the Chinese Consulate General in Chiang Mai donated office equipment to the Royal Thai Police Fifth Provincial Region. The donation was provided to thank the Fifth Police District for its long-term work in protecting the safety of Chinese citizens in northern Thailand and combating transnational crime. The monetary value of the donation is unknown. This is the second donation provided to the Fifth Police District in 2023. The first donation was provided in March 2023 (Record ID 107493).

title: Chinese government donates 26 motorcycles and 100 computers to Sri Lankan Police
description: On November 10, 2023, the Chinese government donated 26 Ranomoto motorcycles and 100 Lenovo desktop computers to the Sri Lanka Police.

title: Chinese Embassy in Sri Lanka donates fabric to Sri Lankan police department in March 2023
description: On March 15, 2023, the Chinese Embassy in Sri Lanka held a handover ceremony for the donation of fabrics to make police uniforms to the Sri Lankan police department. According to the Chinese Embassy in Sri Lanka, the fabric can be used to provide two sets of standard police uniforms to 45,000 police officers.

title: Chinese Embassy donates 250 bulletproof jackets to Islamabad, Punjab, and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police in Pakistan
description: On March 15, 2023, the Chinese Embassy donated 250 bulletproof jackets to Islamabad Capital Police, Punjab Police, and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police in Pakistan. A total of 50 bulletproof jackets were provided to Islamabad Capital Police, 100 jackets to the Punjab Police, and 100 jackets to the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police.

title: The People’s Liberation Army of China provides anti-epidemic materials to Belarusian Army in June 2020
description: On June 13, 2020, the People’s Liberation Army of China provided anti-epidemic materials to the armed forces of Belarus. The donated materials included protective suits, medical masks, and other anti epidemic materials. The monetary value of this donation is unknown.

title: Chinese Government donates 5 police motorcycles to Bolivia
description: On August 4th, 2021, the Chinese ambassador Huang Yazhong attended the donation ceremony of 5 police motorcycles and accompanying protective clothing at the La Paz South Police Station. Roberto Ríos, Deputy Minister of Civil Security of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Bolivia, and Jhonny Aguilera, Commander-in-Chief of the National Police attended the event. title: Chinese military sponsors development of shooting range at the Royal Gendarmerie Training Center
description: On December 17, 2021 the Cambodian Deputy Prime Minister and Defense Minister General Tea Banh and Chinese ambassador to Cambodia Wang Wentian presided over the groundbreaking ceremony for a new shooting range at the Royal Gendarmerie Training Center. The Royal Gendarmerie Training Center will built a shooting range on 105 hectares, and the project is supported by the Chinese military. According to General Banh, the shooting range will serve as the venue for the 2023 Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Armies Rifle Meet.

title: Chinese Government donates 30 fire trucks to Cambodia
description: On April 8, 2006, China and Cambodia signed an Exchange of Notes Agreements to provide 30 firetrucks for Cambodia. On the afternoon of May 10, 2007, Cambodian Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of the Interior, Kennedy, personally presided over the handover of 30 fire engines to the Royal Government of Cambodia in the Cambodian capital of Phnom Penh. Mrs. Zhang Jinfeng, China's Ambassador to Cambodia, and Mr. Hok Lundy, National Police Chief of Cambodia, singed the Certificate of Delivery and Receipt on behalf of China and Cambodia respectively on May 14, 2007. title: People's Liberation Army of China donates humanitarian supplies in March 2020 to Cambodia
description: On March 21, 2020, the People's Liberation Army donated Covid materials to the Cambodian government amidst a joint-training exercise. The supplies included 15,000 sets of study, sport and medical materials. A ceremony was held on Saturday, March 21st at a military training field in Cambodia's Kampot province in the presence of military personnel from both nations as well as local officials, medical workers and students for the donation. description: On July 12, 2017, a Mandarin Center officially opened at the Ministry of Defense of Cambodia. Established by the Confucius Institute, the Center provides Chinese language training at beginner and intermediate levels.

title: Chinese Ministry of Defense donates military band and medical equipment to Cambodia
description: On December 6, 2007, the Ministry of National Defense of the People's Republic of China donated military band equipment to the Royal Army of Cambodia and medical equipment to the Preah Ket Mealea Hospital in Cambodia (or 向柬埔寨王家军提供军乐团装备与医疗设备). It is part of a RMB 30 million pledge to Cambodia for the renovation and donation to the hospital and the construction of a Chinese-Cambodian Friendship Infantry Institution. description: On February 26, 2018, China’s Ministry of Defense provided 24 kinds of medical equipment to the state-run Preah Ket Mealea military hospital to support heart and blood treatments (or 中国国防部援助柬埔寨王家军医疗物资). The medical equipment donated included scanning machines and operating tools, specifically a 128-layer CT system, extracorporeal circulation machine, cardiac ultrasound equipment, and other modern medical equipment. The equipment was estimated to be worth approximately $5 million USD. On the same day, the Chinese side also sent an aid team consisting of six doctors to provide technical support

title: Chinese government signs agreement for Security Annex of the Prime Minister's Office Project in Cambodia
description: On February 14, 2017, the implementation agreement for the construction of the security annex of the Cambodian Prime Minister's Office by the Chinese government was signed in Phnom Penh. Li An, Economic and Commercial Counsellor in Cambodia, and the Senior Minister Yim Nola, and Chairman of the China-Cambodia Friendship Promotion Committee signed the agreement. The project is also called Security Auxiliary Building of the Prime Minister’s Office in Cambodia and 柬首相府安全附楼项目 in Chinese. _x000D_ _x000D_ The design contract was signed on December 8th, 2015 by Hu'nan Architectural Design Institute a

title: China provides anti-mining equipments to Cambodia
description: On November 20, 2017, China provided Cambodia with anti-mining equipment for humanitarian reasons. The equipment delivered includes 40 motors, 14 laptops, ten iPads, 340 military tents, 1,400 wheelchairs, 18 blasting tools, 18 metal detectors, 18 demining tool kits, and 18 protective devices. China’s ambassador to Cambodia Xiong Bo said that contributions on mine clearance will increase the safety of many Cambodians.

title: Chinese government donates 104 police motorcycles to Cambodia
description: On September 25, 2007, China donated 104 police motorcycles to the Cambodian Cambodian Ministry of Interior. The motorcycles are to be used to help support the Cambodian police.

title: China provides Technical de-mining course to Royal Cambodian Air Force (RCAF) (Part 2) (Linked to ID #38796)
description: From December 5, 2013 to January 14, 2014, a de-mining course was held in Kampong Speu Province. The course was sponsored by the People's Liberation Army of China (PLA) for the Royal Cambodian Air Force (RCAF), and was the second phase of China's support of humanitarian mine clearance technology within Cambodia. The course was 6 weeks long, with 2 weeks of theoretical training and 4 weeks of field training, and 52 RCAF members participated in the course. The closing ceremony for the course was held on January 14, 2014, at the Cambodia Peacekeeping Mine Clearance Training Institute. Phase I of

title: China provides Technical de-mining course to Royal Cambodian Air Force (RCAF) (Part 1) (Linked to ID #34798)
description: On November 5, 2012, an opening ceremony for the first phase of the technical de-mining course Royal Cambodian Air Force (RCAF) sponsored by the People's Liberation Army of China (PLA) was held in Oudong, Cambodia. The closing ceremony for the course was held on December 13, 2012, and 52 members of the RCAF participated. Phase II of the de-mining initiative is captured in project #38798.

title: China provides Various Training Programs for 95 Cambodian Students
description: In 2010, a total of 95 Cambodian students from core government sectors and social groups had attended 41 various training programs in China. The programs cover fields/issues such as financial crisis and economic recovery, industry, agriculture, transportation, health, communications, infrastructure, environmental protection, tourism, climate, water, SME development and food security. The Cambodian students have found the training useful and relevant in promoting social and economic development.

title: China provides training programs for the new equipment they donated to the Border Police of Bosnia and Herzegovina (Linked to project #66076)
description: On September 13, 2017, the Chinese Government and the Government of Bosnia-Herzegovina signed an exchange of notes, which committed RMB 38 million of grant funding for the provision of customs inspection equipment. RMB 30 million of the grant proceeds were drawn from an Economic and Technical Cooperation (ETCA) that the parties signed on the same day. The remaining RMB 8 million was drawn from an ETCA that the parties signed on September 17, 2015. The purpose of this project was to provide customs inspection equipment to the Border Police of Bosnia and Herzegovina for use at international air

title: Chinese Government donates ambulances, buses, cars, and other items to Royal Cambodian Armed Forces
description: On November 24, 2008, the Chinese Ministry of Defense officially delivered a batch of donated equipment — including 33 ambulances, 7 minibuses, 1 bus, 3 cars, 1 excavator, 5 water pumps, 5 sawmills, 5 road-cutting machines, and 5 emergency electricity generators — to the Cambodian Ministry of Defense (Royal Cambodian Armed Forces). The purpose of the donation was to increase the capacities of the Cambodian Ministry of Defense in emergency natural disaster situations.

title: Chinese government donates 400 police motorcycles to Cambodia
description: The Chinese government agreed to give 400 police motorcycles to the Cambodian Ministry of Interior on March 23, 2004 (援助柬埔寨400辆警用摩托车 in Chinese). The motorcycles will be used to help support the Cambodian police. The motorcycles were delivered on March 11th, 2005 ("图文：中国援助柬埔寨400辆警用摩托车(1)").

title: Chinese Government Donates Container Scanning System to Cambodia in 2007
description: On April 8, 2006, the governments of China and Cambodia signed the Exchange of Letters agreement, "The Government of the People's Republic of China presents a container inspection to the Royal Government of Cambodia". On April 28, 2006, the Ministry of Commerce of the People’s Republic of China discussed the tender mode of the Cambodia Container Inspection Equipment assistance project. The bidding method for the aid to Cambodia was studied and the Tender Committee decided to negotiate with Tsinghua Tongfang Weishi Technology Co., Ltd. (known as Nuchtech Company Ltd. in English) for the projec

title: China trains 150 professionals from Cabo Verde in China in 2019
description: In 2019, 150 professionals from Cabo Verde were selected to visit China to participate in training seminars promoted by the International Training Centre and the Chinese Ministry of Commerce. The professionals include police officers, military personnel, journalists, economist, salespeople, computer and health technicians, and civil servants.

title: China sends experts from the Criminal Investigation Police University of China (CIPUC) to Cape Verde to train police officers in 2017 (linked to #57041)
description: From June 19 to September 15, 2017, at the invitation from Cape Verde, 4 professors from the Criminal Investigation Police University of China (CIPUC) and 2 interpreters visited Cape Verde to provide 3 months of training for more than 100 local Cape Verdean police officers. The event took place within the scope of the Technical-Police Cooperation Program existing between Cape Verde and the People's Republic of China._x000D_ _x000D_ The training took place at the National Police Training Center in Praia from June 19, 2017 to September 15, 2017. This seminar consisted of 4 specialty courses, nam

title: China provides China-based training for Cape Verde police in 2016 (linked to #57043)
description: On March 2, 2016, China and the Cape Verde Police Department met and exchanged opinions on implementing the training for police officers of Cape Verde. The Deputy Chief of Cape Verde Police Department agreed to lead a team of senior police officers to take relevant seminars in China._x000D_ _x000D_ In 2017, China trained more Cape Verdean police officers, which is recorded in project #57043. The capacity of this training seminar is unknown. The status of this project is also unclear.

title: Chinese Government provides grant — via ETCA — for São Vicente Marine Special Economic Zone Planning Project
description: On December 14, 2013, China Road & Bridge Corporation (CRBC) met with Cape Verde's President and Prime Minister to discuss the possibility of building a deep water port at Mindelo on Porto Grande Bay as well as a cruise ship terminal, and the possibility of refurbishing Cabnave shipyard on São Vicente island. On July 6, 2017, the Chinese Government and the Government of Cape Verde signed an Economic and Technical Cooperation Agreement (ETCA), which committed grant funding for the São Vicente Marine Special Economic Zone Planning Project. Then, on January 10 and 11, 2018, Chinese and Cape Verde

receiving_agency: Burundi Ministry of Public Security and Disaster Management
title: Chinese Embassy funds multi-functional stadium in Burundi
description: On February 2, 2020, the Chinese Ambassador to Burundi Li Changlin attended the handover ceremony of the multi-functional stadium of the Ministry of Public Security and Disaster Management. Melchiade RUCEKE, director of the Ministry of Public Security in Burundi, and Wang Yuan, political counselor of the Chinese Embassy in Burundi, attended the ceremony. The stadium was funded by the Chinese Embassy in Burundi and undertaken by China Geological Engineering Corporation.

title: Chinese Embassy provides motorcycles to the Ministry of Defense of Burkina Faso in November 2021
description: On November 19, 2021, the Chinese Embassy provided off-road motorcycles to the Ministry of Defense of Burkina Faso. This donation was made to support the transportation operations of the ministry. The monetary value of this donation is unknown. A handover ceremony was held for this donation. China’s Ambassador to Burkina Faso, Li Jian, and the Secretary General of the Burkina Faso Ministry of Defense, Senior Colonel Ouedraogo, attended the ceremony and signed the handover certificate.

title: Chinese army donates anti-epidemic materials to Bulgarian army in July 2020
description: On July 3, 2020, the handover ceremony of the anti-epidemic materials aided by the Chinese army to the Bulgarian army was held at the Sofia Military Medical Academy. On July 2, 2020, the anti-epidemic materials aided by the Chinese army to the Bulgarian Army arrived in Sofia smoothly. The materials include 13 types of anti-epidemic equipment such as masks, protective clothing, and goggles.

receiving_agency: Municipality of Recife|Pernambuco State Military Police Association
title: China donates 1200 Christmas gift bags to the Recife City Government and the Pernambuco State Military Police Association in December 2021
description: On December 15, 2021, the Consulate General of the People's Republic of China in Recife, through the Recife Overseas Chinese Association, donated 1200 Christmas gift bags to the Recife City Government and the Pernambuco State Military Police Association. The donation will be distributed to local poor families, the military, and the police. The USD value of the donation is unknown. The donation was part of the "Love from China" charity activity, which aims to thank Recife City for its protection of local overseas Chinese citizens. This event marks the seventh year that China has hosted the "L

title: Wuxi Police College in China provides training for Punjab Assistant Superintendents of Police
description: In September 2023, the Inspector General of Punjab Police, Dr. Usman Anwar, announced a collaborative initiative with the Wuxi Police Training College in China. This program aims to send Assistant Superintendents of Police (ASPs) from Punjab to China for specialized training in operational and investigative techniques, including advanced drone technology. The objective is to enhance the professionalism, operational efficiency, and investigative skills of Punjab's police force through bilateral cooperation.

title: Chinese Government donates police equipment to Sindh police, Pakistan, November 2023
description: On November 1, 2023, the Consul General in Karachi, Yang Yundong, held a handover ceremony was held for police equipment donated to the police department of Sindh, in Pakistan. The exact breakdown, amount, and monetary value of the supplies given are all unknown.

title: Chinese government donates equipment to the Kiribati Police Service in 2023
description: On November 24, 2023, there was a handover ceremony for the Chinese-donated police equipment to the Kiribati Police Service (KPS) at the Police Headquarters in Betio. Chinese Ambassador to Kiribati Zhou Limin, KPS Acting Commissioner Eeri Aritiera, officials from the Chinese Embassy, the Assistance Police team from China, and the Senior Management Group from KPS attended the handover ceremony. The batch of equipment included brass band equipment, mobile phones, tablets, traffic cones and vests, sports wear, etc. The monetary value of this donation is unknown.

title: China builds disarmament training center in South Sudan
description: In April 2013, Chinese UN peacekeepers constructed interim training centers for Disarmament, Demobilization, and Reintegration (DDR) in South Sudan, which will teach new skills to around 400 ex-militants. The peacekeepers also constructed a road through forests and swamps in order to ease access to the center. The transaction information on the agreement of peacekeeping operations and costs of construction are unknown.

title: China donates 38 computers to South Sudan's ruling SPLM party
description: On April 5, 2018, the Chinese Embassy in South Sudan donated 38 computers to the Sudan People's Liberation Movement, the ruling party of South Sudan. The total value of the donation is unknown.

title: China holds training program for Philippine Coast Guard officers
description: From May 4 to 20, 2017, the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) Legal Affairs seminar and the Junior Officers Law Enforcement training course took place in Ningbo City, Zheijang Province, China. Ten PCG legal officers participated in the legal affairs seminar while the rest of the PCG officers took the law enforcement training course. According to "20 PCG officers training on maritime law enforcement in China," the 2-week program includes an "introduction to the maritime law enforcement agencies in China, maritime law enforcement language (Chinese), maritime search and rescue, diving, boarding and

receiving_agency: Government of Democratic Republic of Congo
title: Chinese government sends 21st peacekeeping mission to DRC
description: On September 12, 2017, the first batch of peacekeepers in the 21st Peacekeeping mission set off for the DRC. The 218 peacekeepers in total came from the engineering unit and medical unit. The second batch of peacekeepers will set off on September 18 with 118 peacekeepers. The peacekeeping mission is likely supporting the United Nations Organization Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo or MONUSCO. The mission was completed in September 2018.

title: Chinese government sends 20th peacekeeping mission to DRC from the medical and engineering units
description: On September 19, 2016, the 20th Peacekeeping mission set off for the DRC. The 218 peacekeepers in total came from the engineering unit and medical unit. The peacekeeping mission is likely supporting the United Nations Organization Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo or MONUSCO. The mission was completed in September 2017. As of July 2017, the 20th peacekeeping mission had completed 31 engineering investigations, 35 construction tasks, and 19 medical operations and had treated 1,430 patients.

receiving_agency: Government of Democratic Republic of Congo
title: Chinese government sends 19th peacekeeping mission to DRC
description: On September 21, 2015, the first batch of peacekeepers in the 19th Peacekeeping mission set off for the DRC. The 225 peacekeepers in total came from the engineering unit and medical unit. The second batch of peacekeepers will set off on September 27. The peacekeeping mission is likely supporting the United Nations Organization Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo or MONUSCO. The mission was completed in September 2016.

receiving_agency: United Nations Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS)
title: Chinese Government sends 350 non-combat peacekeepers to South Sudan (Linked to Record ID#41573)
description: In May 2014, the Chinese Government agreed to send 850 peacekeepers to support the United Nations Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS). The Chinese foreign ministry confirmed this in June of the same year. Then, in September 2014, the Chinese Government announced that it would send 700 combat troops (as captured by linked Record ID#41573). These combat troops began arriving in January 2015, joining existing 350 Chinese peacekeeping medical workers and engineers in Juba, South Sudan captured in this project. There were 1,031 Chinese peacekeepers in South Sudan in December 2015, including the battal

title: China provides emergency water supplies to Male, Maldives (link to Record ID#38403)
description: In early December 2014, China sent water bottles on commercial airliners including 32.5 tons of water from Mega Maldives and China Southern Airlines and 5 tons of water bottles from Emirates (following urgent contact on the part of CMEC, a Chinese machinery company) to the Maldives. In addition, China had the People's Liberation Army Navy (PLAN) Changxingdao warship deliver 600 tons of drinking water to Male Port. Then the PLAAF sent two planes to deliver 40 tons of water to Male International Airport. The project is linked to Record ID#38403 where China provided a $500,000 emergency grant

title: China Ministry of Defense sends ships and aircraft to help find AirAsia QZ8501 plane crash (Linked to Record ID#39125)
description: On December 29th, 2014, China announced it would send aircraft and vessels to join the search and rescue for missing AirAsia flight QZ8501. On December 30, 2014, the Chinese Ministry of National Defense sent ships and an aircraft to assist in the search for the crashed AirAsia flight QZ8501 that went missing on December 28. The search mission was led by Indonesia. The flight was scheduled to land in Singapore but crashed in the waters off Belitung island. In January 2015, China Civil Aviation Authority also sent three experts to assist in the search (see Record ID#39125). As of January 9th, 2

receiving_agency: Government of Democratic Republic of Congo
title: Chinese government sends 18th peacekeeping mission to DRC
description: On December 16 2014, the peacekeepers in the 18th Peacekeeping mission arrived in the DRC. The 218 peacekeepers in total came from the engineering unit and medical unit. The peacekeeping mission is likely supporting the United Nations Organization Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo or MONUSCO. The mission will reportedly last for 8 months.

receiving_agency: Government of Democratic Republic of Congo
title: Chinese government sends 17th peacekeeping mission to DRC
description: On April 16, 2014, the first batch of peacekeepers in the 17th Peacekeeping mission set off for the DRC. The 218 peacekeepers in total came from the engineering unit and medical unit. The second batch of peacekeepers will set off 10 days later with 118 peacekeepers. The peacekeeping mission is likely supporting the United Nations Organization Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo or MONUSCO. The mission will reportedly last for 8 months. On November 11, 2014, a ceremony was held to honor the 17th peacekeeping mission.

title: Chinese engineers clear landmines in South Lebanon
description: In 2013, a Chinese engineer brigade, part of a UN peacekeeping force, were on a mission to clear landmines in Southern Lebanon. The landmines were remnants from the conflict in the region in 2006. China has previously sent money and equipment to Lebanon specifically for clearing landmines in the past.

receiving_agency: Ecuador Ministry of Internal and External Security Coordination
title: Chinese Embassy in Ecuador donates computers, printers, and a connectivity system to Ecuadorian police in 2023
description: On April 28, 2023, the Chinese Embassy in Ecuador donated 100 computers and printers to police in Ecuador, as well as a connectivity system aimed to improve cybersecurity measures. The monetary value of the donated items is unknown. The donation was received in a ceremony attended by the Chinese Ambassador to Ecuador and Ecuador's Minister of the Interior. The Minister of the Interior noted that these materials would be deployed in the cities most affected by crime.

title: Chinese peacekeeping medical team provides medical care to South Sudanese in Babi village
description: On March 3, 2012, a group of doctors from the Chinese UN peacekeeping medical team in South Sudan visited the village of Babi to offer medical care to local people. During this visit they gave medicine, conducted checkups, and provided health education.

receiving_agency: Government of Democratic Republic of Congo
title: Chinese government sends 14th peacekeeping mission to DRC
description: On March 20, 2012, the first batch of peacekeepers in the 14th Peacekeeping mission set off for the DRC. The 218 peacekeepers in total came from the engineering unit and medical unit. The second batch of peacekeepers will set off in late March with 118 peacekeepers. The peacekeeping mission is likely supporting the United Nations Organization Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo or MONUSCO. The mission will reportedly last for 8 months.

title: Chinese government sends 15th peacekeeping mission to DRC
description: On November 27, 2012, the first batch of peacekeepers in the 15th Peacekeeping mission set off for the DRC. The 218 peacekeepers in total came from the engineering unit and medical unit. The second batch of peacekeepers will set off 10 days later with 118 peacekeepers. The peacekeeping mission is likely supporting the United Nations Organization Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo or MONUSCO. The mission will reportedly last for 8 months.

title: Chinese government sends 13th peacekeeping mission to DRC
description: On July 18, 2011, the first batch of peacekeepers in the 13th Peacekeeping mission set off for the DRC. The 218 peacekeepers came from the engineering unit and medical unit. The second batch of peacekeepers will set off in late July with 118 peacekeepers. The peacekeeping mission is likely supporting the United Nations Organization Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo or MONUSCO.

title: Chinese Government sends peacekeeping police force to Cyprus
description: In 2011, the Chinese Government deployed peacekeeping police to Cyprus to support the United Nations Peacekeeping Force in Cyprus (UNFICYP), which was established under United Nations Security Council Resolution 186 in 1964 to prevent a return of violence following intercommunal fighting between Greek Cypriots and Turkish Cypriots.

title: China sends an additional 43 relief workers to Haiti (Linked to Record ID#85824)
description: On January 21, 2010, the Chinese government announced a 43 person medical care and epidemic prevention team would help assist disaster relief efforts in Haiti following a magnitude 7.3 earthquake. The team arrived on January 25 and left on February 9, and team members were from China's military medical system. 70 percent of them had participated in previous UN peacekeeping missions. They brought with them medical supplies worth 18 million RMB (see Record ID#85824). The team will be replacing another 60 member team, consisting of medical professionals and individuals working on search and resc

receiving_agency: Government of Democratic Republic of Congo
title: Chinese government sends 12th peacekeeping mission to DRC
description: On November 19, 2010, the first batch of peacekeepers in the 12th Peacekeeping mission set off for the DRC. The 100 peacekeepers came from the engineering unit and medical unit. The second batch of peacekeepers with 118 peacekeepers will set off later. The mission will reportedly last for 8 months. The peacekeeping mission is likely supporting the United Nations Organization Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo or MONUSCO.

title: China donates emergency supplies to the Gabonese military through Peace Angel 2009 (linked to ID #532 and ID#286)
description: Between June 21 and 28, 2009 the Chinese gave the Gabonese military ten shipping containers including tents, medicine, laboratory equipment, and mobile medical units. The equipment will be stocked at four locations around the country for use during emergencies. A financial amount for this project, as well as contacts, are unknown. This donation was part of the Peace Angel 2009 military training held June 21-28, 2009 in Makokou, Ogooue-Ivindo Province. The training also included professional development and a rescue exercise (captured in ID#286) and medical aid (captured in ID#532).

title: China sends engineers to Darfur as part of UN Peacekeeping Mission to construct roads, camps, and wells
description: On May 8, 2007, China announced that it would send an engineering unit to join a UN-led peacekeeping force in Darfur, Sudan. The first batch of 135 engineers and troops of a total of 315 were deployed in Darfur in November 24, 2007. Their main task was to build camps, roads and to dig wells to allow for the deployment of more peacekeepers. On January 12, 2008, the first batch of engineers left for China and were replaced by a team of 160 engineers. The third batch of 172 arrived in July 2008. In March 2011, a fifth detachment of engineers arrived to take part in the Darfur peacekeeping missio

title: China grants African Union financial aid for peacekeeping mission in Somalia in 2007
description: On August 27, 2007, Lin Lin, the Chinese Ambassador to Ethiopia and Representative to the African Union (AU) granted financial aid to Alpha Oumar Konaré, Chairman of the Commission of the African Union. This aid was intended for the peacekeeping mission in Somalia (African Union Mission in Somalia - AMISOM), which was founded in the same year. The exact monetary value of this grant is unknown.

title: China sends 15th peacekeeping team to Sudan
description: On December 11, 2018, a group of 100 Chinese Peacekeepers left for Darfur, Sudan for a year-long peacekeeping mission. This is the first group of the 225-member peace-keeping force team, with the second group leaving on December 18 for Darfur. Together, the 225-member team is the 15th batch of peacekeepers that China has sent to the Darfur region. The team will be tasked with maintaining supplies, engineering projects, renovating buildings, and constructing/repairing homes, roads, and airports. On December 4, 2019, the United Nations Peacekeeping Strategic Partnership Office evaluated the 15t

receiving_agency: Government of Democratic Republic of Congo
title: Chinese government sends 23rd peacekeeping mission troupe to the Democratic Republic of the Congo
description: In September 2019, the Chinese government dispatched its 23rd peacekeeping mission troupe to the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The team had returned to China on September 16, 2020. According to CCTV via the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation the peacekeeping mission had over 200 members, with 90 officers and soldiers dispatched in the first batch (88 of the 90 were members of the engineering team). The team had completed 53 engineering tasks in one year, invested 19,437 man-hours, mobilized 6,520 units of equipment, repaired 62.64 kilometers of roads, leveled 20,216 square meters of ground,

title: Chinese Government provides 3,600 food parcels to families in Beirut, Lebanon in September 2020
description: In September 29th 2020, the Chinese Embassy in Lebanon provided 3,600 food parcels to poor families in Beirut, Lebanon affected by the Beirut port explosion. The monetary value of the donation is unknown. The packages were delivered to the Lebanese army, which was tasked with distributing the parcels to approximately 15,000 people. The purpose of this donation is to support Lebanon during the aftermath of the Beirut port explosion.

title: 18th Chinese peacekeeping force donates medical supplies to Marjayoun District in August 2020 (Linked to Record ID#67574)
description: On August 10, 2020, the 18th Chinese peacekeeping force dispatched to Lebanon donated a batch of medical supplies to the local government of Marjayoun District, where it was stationed. The supplies included medicines for external use, preventive medicines, and some medical apparatus and instruments. The monetary value of the donation is unknown. The 18th Chinese peacekeeping force dispatched to Lebanon is captured and detailed in Record ID#67574.

title: Chinese Embassy donates office supplies to police in Santiago and Maio, Cabo Verde, May 2023
description: On May 25, 2023, the Chinese embassy in Cabo Verde donated a batch of office supplies to the Cabo Verde National Police in Santiago and the island of Maio. The type and amount of supplies and their monetary value are all unknown.

receiving_agency: Government of Tunisia|Tunisian Ministry of National Defense
title: Chinese Government donates medical supplies to Tunisia in August 2022
description: On August 2, 2022, Chinese Ambassador to Tunisia Zhang Jianguo and Major General Fergani, Director General of the Military Medical Services of the Tunisian Ministry of Defense, signed the certificate of handover of medical supplies donated by China to Tunisia. The supplies consist of a batch of ventilators and oxygen concentrators (see source ID #199407). The monetary value of this donation is unknown.

title: Chinese Embassy donates forensic laboratory equipment to Timor-Leste in 2022
description: On December 12, 2022, the Chinese Embassy donated forensic DNA laboratory equipment to the Government of Timor-Leste. The purpose of the equipment provided is to strengthen criminal investigations in Timor-Leste. Timor-Leste's Minister of Justice, Amaral and the Chief Police, Vincent attended the event. The specific financial value, or quantity of the equipment is unknown.

title: Chinese Consulate General in Cape Town donates 56 mountain bikes to Wastern Cape Town Neighborhood Watch in 2022
description: On 20 September 2022, acting Consul General of China Tang Changan and his delegation donated 56 mountain bikes to the Department of Community Safety of Western Cape Town Neighborhood Watch. It was handed over to Minister Reagen Allen, Minister of Police Oversight and Community Safety. The donation will support accredited Neighborhood Watch structures in their significant work across the province to create safer communities in the Western Cape.

title: Chinese Embassy donates E-Learning Center to Peace Mission Training Center in South Africa
description: On September 30, 2022, Chinese Ambassador Chen Xiaodong unveiled the E-Learning Center for the Peace Mission Training Center controlled by South Africa's Defense Forces. This new component to the structure has been donated in kind by the Chinese Embassy to enable the institution to provide exceptional research facilities to its personnel as well as learners attending courses at the PMTC.

title: Chinese government donates police vehicles to Solomon Islands police force
description: On November 4, 2022, the handover ceremony of police vehicles (riot control vehicles and motorcycles) donated by China to the Solomon Islands was held at the headquarters of the Solomon Islands Police Force. The donation was made in response to social unrest that broke out in Honiara, the capital of the Solomon Islands, in November 2021. The donation will further effectively enhance the law enforcement, patrol, anti-riot and social security capabilities of the police force.

title: China donates first aid dummies to the Seychelles Police Academy
description: On December 29, 2022, the Chinese ambassador handed over a donation of several first aid dummies to the Commissioner of Police, Ted Barbe, at the Seychelles Police Academy. The donation was done in the presence of other representatives of the Chinese embassy and senior police officers.

title: Chinese Government provides 1000 bullet proof vests to Royal Papua New Guinea Constabulary in August 2022
description: On August 19, 2022, the Chinese Government donated 1000 high quality bullet proof vests to Royal Papua New Guinea Constabulary. The supplies were distributed to front-line police forces in the highlands on August 20, 2022. The donation will enhance police capabilities and improve their completion of election security duties. The monetary value of this donation is unknown. A handover ceremony was held for this donation. China’s Ambassador to Papua New Guinea, Zeng Fanhua, and Inspector General of PNG Police, David Manning, attended the ceremony and signed the material handover certificate.

title: Chinese Government donated 10 motorcycles to Panama City Police Department
description: On December 15, 2022, the Chinese Ambassador to Panama attended a handover ceremony of 10 motorcycles to Panama City's police force. The motorcycles were donated from an unknown agency within the Chinese Government. According to the ambassador, this donation is to help the Panamanian city government improve the hardware construction of the police force and better serve to ensure social security and citizen safety in the capital.

title: Chinese Ministry of Public Security provides equipment to the National Police of Nicaragua
description: On November 8, 2022, the Chinese Ministry of Public Security donated protective equipment to the National Police of Nicaragua, including helmets, bulletproof vests, shields, batons, knee pads, handcuffs, and gloves. Francisco Díaz Madriz, Director General of the National Police of Nicaragua, and Chen Xi, Chinese Ambassador to Nicaragua, were present during the donation.

title: Chinese Ministry of Public Security pledged information equipment to the Maldives Police Service in February 2022
description: On February 22, 2022, the Chinese Ministry of Public Security pledged a donation of information equipment to the Maldives Police Service. The Chinese government formalized the pledged equipment assistance through a formalized Exchange of Notes at a ceremony attended by Chinese Ambassador Wang Lixin and Commissioner of Police Mohamed Hameed. The batch of information equipment will include computers and servers. The monetary value of the donation is unknown.

title: Chinese Government donates police materials to Madagascar Ministry of Public Security in November 2022
description: On November 4, 2022, the Chinese government donated police materials to the Madagascar Ministry of Public Security. The donation includes an unknown quantity of anti-riot helmets, bulletproof vests, and batons. The monetary value of the donation is unknown.

title: Chinese Embassy in Liberia donates supplies to the Liberia Police Academy
description: On September 23, 2022, the Chinese Embassy in Liberia donated a batch of daily necessities, including solar street lights, to the Liberia Police Academy community. Ambassador Ren Yisheng, Community Chairman Mr. Nyumah A. Borbor, and his delegation attended the ceremony. The monetary value of the donation is unknown. The donation is intended to strengthen grassroots community infrastructure and enhance China-Liberia relations.

title: Chinese government donates equipment to Kiribati Police Service
description: On November 24, 2022, there was a handover ceremony for the Chinese-donated police equipment to the Kiribati Police Service at the Police Headquarters in Betio. The government of the People's Republic of China represented by Ambassador Zhou Limin has handed over police equipment including brass band equipment, mobile phones, tablets, traffic cones and vests, sport wear, and many more to the Acting Commissioner Mr Eeri Aritiera. These equipment will be used by the KPS for the enhancement of its services to the people of Kiribati. This handing over ceremony was witnessed by officials from the

title: Chinese Government Donates Aid to Guinea-Bissau's Defense Ministry (March 2022)
description: On March 3, 2022 China donated materials to Guinea-Bissau's Ministry of Defense including eight vehicles, cartography and office materials, and military engineering machines. The monetary value of this donation is unknown.

title: Chinese Embassy donates logistic equipment to Gambia Armed Forces
description: On December 30, H.E. Liu Jin, Chinese Ambassador to The Gambia handed over a batch of logistic equipment to Gambia Armed Forces. The donation included eight double cabin pickup trucks, two single cabin pickup trucks, multiple other trucks, two water tank trucks, two vehicle lifters, one container, and one ambulance. The total cost of the donation is unknown. The purpose of the donation is to aid in peacekeeping efforts and support military training efforts.

title: Chinese Ministry of Public Security donates police supplies to Djibouti National Police Force
description: On November 28, 2022, the Chinese Ministry of Public Security (Chinese:中国公安部援) donated supplies to Djibouti National Police.

receiving_agency: Democratic Republic of Congo Ministry of Defense
title: Chinese Embassy in the Democratic Republic of the Congo donates information technology equipment to Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ministry of National Defense in December 2022
description: On December 23, 2022, Charge d'Affaires of the Chinese Embassy in the Democratic Republic of the Congo Wang Hailong donated information equipment to the Ministry of Defense of Democratic Republic of the Congo. The donation was received by Secretary General of the Ministry of Defense Lu Kuikira, and was made on the behalf of Chinese Ambassador to Democratic Republic of the Congo, Zhu Jing.

title: Chinese Government provides grant for construction of auditorium at Cambodia's Army Institute
description: On March 28, 2022, construction began for an Chinese Government grant-funded auditorium at Cambodia's Army Institute in Phnom Sruoch District within Kampong Speu Province. The monetary value of the grant from the Chinese Government is unknown. The auditorium is expected to consist of 5 floors and will be used for human resources training purposes. When completed, the auditorium is expected to improve Cambodia’s training abilities and national defense operations. Yunnan Construction and Investment Holding Group Co. Ltd. is the contractor responsible for implementation. A groundbreaking cerem

title: Chinese medical peacekeeping contingent donates flood relief supplies to Mali
description: On August 11, 2021, the 8th Chinese medical peacekeeping contingent to Mali donated more than 600 pieces of emergency supplies to flood-stricken areas in Menaka, Mali. The donation was delivered to the affected area through the logistics department of the Mali military.

receiving_agency: United Nations Multidimensional Integrated Stabilization Mission in Mali (MINUSMA)
title: China sends 9th batch of peacekeeping forces to Mali
description: On October 23rd, 2021, China sent peacekeeping engineering contingency forces to Menaka, Mali as a part of the United Nations Multidimensional Integrated Stabilization Mission (MINUSMA). This is the ninth batch of peacekeeping forces China has sent as part of MINUSMA. The contingency consisted of 38 Chinese officers and soldiers. According to the Chinese Government, the contingency will carry out nine engineering tasks, including building bunkers, repairing roads, and erecting board houses. The mission period is 10 months.

funder: CNOOC Petroleum North America ULC (formerly CNOOC Canada Holding Ltd and Nexen Energy ULC)
title: CNOOC Petroleum North America ULC purchased critical items for Calgary's Salvation Army chapter
description: In 2021, CNOOC Petroleum North America ULC purchased unspecified critical items for the Salvation Army's Calgary chapter, most likely to support the chapter's food pantry program.

title: Chinese Embassy in Sri Lanka donates to Sri Lanka Air Force Seva Vanitha Unit in 2020
description: On June 8, 2020, Chinese Embassy in Sri Lanka made a monetary donation to the SLAF Seva Vanitha Unit at Air Force Headquarters. The donation was made by a Chinese delegation led by the Defence Attache of the Chinese Embassy, Senior Colonel Wan Dong to the Commander of the Air Force, Air Marshal Sumangala Dias at the Commanders' Office. The donation was intended to be utilized to further develop SLAF Pre-School Projects conducted by the SLAF Seva Vanitha Unit and to empower family members of SLAF personnel also through the Seva Vanitha Unit.

receiving_agency: Sihanoukville Special Economic Zone Co., Ltd.
title: Overseas Chinese Charity Foundation provides medical equipment to Cambodian provinces in August 2021
description: On August 25, 2021, the Chinese Overseas Chinese Charity Foundation joined hands with Shanxin Lianxin, a public welfare organization, to donate medical equipment to Sihanoukville Koh Kong in Cambodia. The medical equipment included 8 respirators, 48 sets of medical uniforms, and 1,920 medical masks The distribution of respirators is as follows: 3 to the Sihanoukville Provincial Government, 1 to the Koh Kong Provincial Government, 1 to the Kep Provincial Government, 2 to the Kampot Provincial Government, and 1 to the Army Academy. Each province also received 6 sets of the medical uniforms and

title: Chinese company donates MA-60 passenger jet to Cameroon
description: In 2012, the Cameroon Air Forces accepted the donation of a Modern Ark (MA-60) turboprop passenger jet from Xi'an Aircraft Industry Company. This project was financed by a Chinese government grant. The value of this project is unknown.

title: Chinese Ministry of Public Security donates medical supplies to General Police Department of Mongolia
description: On May 13, 2020, the Chinese Ministry of Public Security donated medical supplies including masks, protective clothing, goggles, and other anti-epidemic materials to the General Police Department of Mongolia to show support for the Mongolian police as they battle the pandemic. The monetary value of the donation is unknown.

title: China Donates Equipment to Kyrgyz Police
description: On October 13th 2003, the Ministry of Public Security in China made a donation to Kyrgyzstan police, and it is the third donation from China since 2001. This donation includes 50 Beijing jeeps and an equipment used in detective experiments. It is to help maintain social security in Kyrgyzstan and better protect Kirghiz and Chinese citizens living in the central Asian country from crime.

title: China sends 13th peacekeeping contingent to Liberia composed of policemen
description: On July 11th 2014, China sends its 13th contingent of policemen for a UN peacekeeping mission to Liberia. This 19-member team received training on international laws, first aid, driving, English, and shooting, as well as orientations on the situation in the region. However, its return date could not be found.

title: Chinese company CICO donates 30 police motorcycles to Liberia
description: On July 23, 2012, China Chongqing International Construction Corporation (CICO) donated 30 police motorcycles to the government of Liberia. These motorcycles are mainly donated to the Liberian Police Department, the Immigration Department, and the VIP Security Bureau for security purposes.

receiving_agency: Lesotho Department of Immigration|Lesotho Ministry of Police and Public Safety
title: The Chinese Embassy in Lesotho holds first Chinese language training class for the Lesotho police and immigration departments
description: On May 4, 2018, the Chinese Embassy in Lesotho held the opening ceremony of the first Chinese language training course for the police and immigration departments of Lesotho, aiming to improve the Lesotho police communication skills in order to better cooperate with the Chinese enterprises and expatriates. More than 50 people, including Ambassador Sun Xianghua, the Permanent Secretary of the Lesotho Police Department Tsovana, the principal of Ma Chiben Middle School, the head of the Confucius Classroom, representatives of the Overseas Chinese Police-Civil Cooperation Center, trainees and media

receiving_agency: Lesotho Ministry of Police and Public Safety
title: Chinese Government committed to provide unknown transaction amount donation via March 2019 ETCA for Lesotho policing and public safety
description: On 8 March 2019, Chinese Embassy official Song Changqing signed an exchange of letters with Mr Matela Thabane, the Principal Secretary of Police and Public Safety of Lesotho, in which China committed to donating policing materials to Lesotho. The value, contents, and delivery date of this donation are unknown.

receiving_agency: Lesotho Ministry of Police and Public Safety
title: Chinese Embassy donates community policing kit and funds to Lesotho Ministry of Police and Public Safety
description: On 27 November 2018, the Government of China officially donated "community policing kits" to the Lesotho Ministry of Police and Public Safety. The kits included blankets, gumboots, flashlights, torches and other unspecified materials. The value of this donation is unknown. In the same donation ceremony, China also donated 100,000 M towards greenhouse project at the Police Training College. (Project ID 71554) Furthermore, China has also agreed to donate a fingerprint examination lab to Lesotho at some point in the future.

receiving_agency: Lesotho Ministry of Police and Public Safety
title: China Donates Computers to Lesotho Police
description: On January 29, 2010, the Chinese Ambassador to Lesotho, Gao Deyi, and the Lesotho Chief of Police attended the handover ceremony for China's donation of 10 desktop computers to the Lesotho police station.

title: Chinese Government provides equipment for postwar mine removal activities
description: In 2002, China donated landmine detection equipment to Lebanon. The initial agreement was signed in 2001. The equipment includes 50 mine detectors and 100 protective jackets. China also sent mine experts and technicians to train the Lebanese army in using the equipment. The value of the equipment is unknown, but a NGO source aggregated landmine equipment donations from China to both Eritrea and Lebanon at $3 million. No financial value has been found for only Lebanon.

funder: China Ministry of National Defense|People's Liberation Army of China
title: China's Defense Ministry provides medical expert team and pneumonia supplies to Laos in April 2020
description: On April 24, 2020, a team of five Chinese military medical experts, with pneumonia treatment materials donated by China's Defense Ministry, arrived in the Lao capital Vientiane. The Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) expert team was greeted at the Wattay International Airport of Vientiane by Lao’s Deputy Defense Minister, Aesamay Leuangvanxay, and Chinese Ambassador to Laos, Jiang Zaidong. At the airport, the medical expert team handed over pneumonia epidemic medical materials to Laos. The materials were carried by cargo planes of the PLA Air Force and were donated by the Ministry of Nati

title: China Ministry of Public Security provides first batch of law enforcement vehicles to Lao Ministry of Public Security in October 2020
description: On October 23, 2020, the Ministry of Public Security of China donated law enforcement vehicles to the Ministry of Public Security of Laos. The vehicles will be used to improve law enforcement capabilities of the Lao Ministry of Public Security (“see 中国援助老挝执法车辆交接仪式在万象举行”). The monetary value of this donation is unknown. A handover ceremony for this donation took place in Vientiane, Laos. Chinese Ambassador Jiang Zaidong and Laos Minister of Public Security attended the ceremony and delivered speeches.

title: People's Liberation Army donates medicine to the Attapeu Provincial Government (Linked to Project ID#88686 and #88761)
description: On August 24, 2019, the People's Liberation Army (PLA), as part of medical assistance provided to Laos under Peace Train-2019, a PLA medical team traveled to the Sanamxay district of the Attapeu Province in southern Laos to provide medical services to the local people (see linked project ID#88686). The district had been the site of severe flooding in July 2018, which the PLA provided medical assistance for (see project ID#65394). At the end of their day-long stay, the PLA medical team donated all of their remaining medicine to the Attapeu Provincial Government. The monetary value of this donat

title: China provides technical trainings for Laos' drug control programs in Yunnan province (linked to #33768)
description: On 24 May 2002, China pledged to provide more technical assistance to Laos in carrying out drug control programmes, specifically covering the training of drug control officials and the provision of alternative crops to replace opium. At a recent meeting for Chinese and Lao drug control officials in Beijing, the two sides outlined methods to strengthen cooperation and the exchange of drug-related information, the development of alternative crops, and to curb drug abuse to combat the problem. In furtherance of the agreement, China has opened a 30-day course on drug control for 30 Lao security o

title: China funds Kilimani Police Station Upgrade Project
description: On January 26, 2016, the launching ceremony for the upgrade project for the Kilimani Police Station in Nairobi Kenya was held. The Chinese Ambassador to Kenya, Liu Xianfa, along with Kenyan police chiefs, government officials, and political figures attended the ceremony. The project is expected to cost 500 million Kenyan shillings and will be implemented in two phases, the first of which is the remodeling and upgrade of offices and residential units at a cost of 300 million Kenyan shillings. The second phase is the construction of new housing units at a cost of 200 million Kenyan shillings. As

title: China sends medical personel and engingeers for UN peacekeeping mission in Liberia (linked to #1552)
description: In December 2003 China joined the UN peacekeeping operations in Liberia by deploying 500 soldiers to the country. A total of 600 Chinese peacekeepers rotated deployment at an 8 month interval between January 2004 and June 2010. The peacekeepers consisted of supplies transport, engineering and medical units, including civilian police, military observers and staff officers. The Engineering and Medical units, captured in this project, are based in Zwedru in UNMIL Sector 4, which covers the southeast region of Liberia. The other units are captured in project ID#1552. China concluded its peacekeep

title: Xinjian Corps of Armed Police Grant Martial Arts Training Course for the Jordanian Public Security Directorate
description: On November 27th, 2012, members of the Jordanian Public Security Directorate (PSD) demonstrated skills learned during a martial arts training course coached by members of the Xinjiang Armed Police Force. The Jordanian PSD invited cooperation with Chinese police and received training from five Chinese policemen as martial arts coaches from November 3, 2012, to December 19th, 2012. At the graduation ceremony Jordanian PSD members demonstrated learned skills such as boxing, stick fighting, Taichi, and enemy apprehension.

receiving_agency: Jordanian Public Security Directorate مديرية الأمن العام
title: Chinese Embassy Provides Policing Materials to the Jordanian Public Security Directorate (PSD)
description: On February 7th, 2018, Chinese Ambassador to Jordan, Pan Weifang, attended a handover ceremony granting unspecified policing materials to the Jordanian Pubic Security Directorate (PSD) on behalf of China's Ministry of Public Security. The intent of the grant is to strengthen Chinese-Jordanian relations in internatinoal law cooperation as well as increase security in countries participating in China's Belt and Road Initiative (BRI).

title: Chinese Government agrees to train 40 Jordanian Government Officials (Linked to Project ID#41029, #41907)
description: On June 19, 2007, China's Assistant Minister of Commerce, Chen Jian, and Jordan's Minister of Planning and International Cooperation, Suhair Al-Ali, signed an agreement, which committed funding for the training of 40 Jordanian Government officials. According to the agreement 30 of the Jordanian officials will come from the public sector, while the remaining 10 come from Jordan's Civil Defense Directorate.

funder: China Ministry of Commerce|China Ministry of Public Security
title: China provides training for 20 Jamaican police officers in 2019
description: According to the Chinese Ministry of commerce, 20 Jamaican police officers traveled to China to take part in the Seminar on Police Capacity Building Seminar for Jamaica. The program was funded by Chinese Ministries of Commerce and Public Security. It took place in Shandong Police College Jinan, Shangdong from October 11th to October 30th. Chinese officials in Jamaica held a pre-departure meeting for the trainees on October 8th. The seminar program started on October 11, 2019, and ended on October 30, 2019.

title: CHEC donates a motorcycle to Spring Hill Police
description: On November 3rd, 2011, China Harbour Engineering Co. and Stewart's Auto Sales Ltd. collaborated to each donate a motorcycle to the Spring Hill Police Station in Portland Parish, Jamaica. Present at the donation handover were Qi Wu Yang, CHEC's Jamaica deputy manager; J. Stewart-Lechler, director of Stewart's Auto Sales; Owen Ellington, commissioner of police; and Daryl Vaz, member of parliament.

title: China provided training seminar on capacity building for 24 officers in the Jamaica Constabulary Force
description: On 24 August 2018, the Chinese Embassy in Jamaica held a send-off meeting for participants of the Seminar on Capacity Building for Jamaica Constabulary Force (JCF). 24 police officers from the JCF traveled to Ji’nan, Shandong Province for the seminar provided by China. The seminar began on 5 September 2018 and ended on 24 September 2018.

funder: Hanban (Confucius Institute Headquarters)|Unspecified Chinese Government Institution
title: Hanban and the Chinese government offer a Chinese language programme to the Jamaica Constabulary Force
description: In 2015, Hanban and the Chinese government introduced the Chinese language programme to the Jamaica Constabulary Force (JCF). According to the JCF 2016 Annual Report, the JCF and the People's Republic of China collaborated to deliver the first Mandarin course to 65 JCF members in 2016. _x000D_ _x000D_ On 11 August 2017, 50 police officers from Jamaica and two police officers from Suriname were awarded certificates for a Chinese training course at National Police College of Jamaica (NPCJ). On 31 August 2018, 68 police officers from Jamaica, Trinidad and Tobago, and Suriname were awarded certifi

title: China Harbour Engineering Co donated two motor vehicles to the Jamaican Constabulary Force (JCF)
description: On 18 December 2014, China Harbour Engineering Company (CHEC) donated two motor vehicles, a Toyota Hiace bus and a Toyota pickup, to the Jamaican Police Force (JCF). The two vehicles will increase the JCF's capacity to provide traffic management and security along the North/South leg of Highway 2000. At the donation ceremony, the Minister of National Security, Peter Bunting, said the vehicles were the first of six being provided by CHEC. However, there are no sources confirming if the other four vehicles were ever donated.

title: China donated office equipment to the Jamaica Constabulary Force
description: On 2 February 2018, the Chinese Embassy in Jamaica donated office equipment to the Jamaica Constabulary Force (JCF). The donation included a printer and an air conditioner, which will improve the working conditions of police officers in the newly-built JCF Emergency Centre on Old Hope Road, Kingston.

receiving_agency: Caribbean Maritime University (CMU)|Cornwall College|National Police College of Jamaica (NPCJ)|Northern Caribbean University (NCU)
title: Hanban signed an agreement on the provision of Chinese language teachers to four Jamaican universities in 2019
description: On August 15, 2019, Hanban, the Caribbean Maritime University (CMU), Northern Caribbean University (NCU), the National Police College of Jamaica, and Cornwall College signed a memorandum of understanding for the provision of Chinese language teachers. The agreement will fly 10 Chinese educators to Jamaica to teach Mandarin at the beginning of the school year in September. By August 2019, over 500 students had signed up for Mandarin classes.

title: Chinese naval hospital ship completes humanitarian medical assistance mission in Jamaica (Linked to Project ID#39102)
description: In 2011, China sent the PLA (People's Liberation Army) Navy hospital ship Peak Ark on a voyage in the Western Hemisphere to provide humanitarian assistance. The Peace Ark traveled through the Caribbean and South America, visiting Cuba, Jamaica, Trinidad and Tobago and Costa Rica. It visited Jamaica from October 29 to November 4. During its 7-day stay, the 100-strong health professionals from the ship conducted over 1500 outpatient consultations, 150 physical checks, 29 surgeries, 18 hospitalized treatments, 89 CAT scans, 307 doppler radar scans, 643 ultrasound scans, 258 ECGs and 499 other tes

title: Chinese Government help to train the Liberian National Police
description: On September 23rd 2017, the fifth Chinese peacekeeping police team in Liberia held a ceremony to consolidate police training in Liberia on the 22nd, marking the successful completion of the 33-day practical skills training. The training started on August 2017. _x000D_ _x000D_ On November 30th, 2017, China's Deputy Inspector General for International Cooperation at the Ministry of Public Security, Ll Ll announced that the Chinese government has committed to continuing assist with the training of the Liberian National Police (LNP) with an emphasis on Form Police Unit (FPU). _x000D_

title: Chinese Government dispatches third police peacekeeping riot team to Liberia in 2015
description: On March 11, 2015, the Chinese Government dispatched China's third peacekeeping police riot team to Liberia for a one-year term as a Formed Police Unit (FPU) under the United Nations Mission in Liberia (UNMIL). The team consisted of 140 members drawn from the Shandong Provincial Public Security Border Defense Corps. The team arrived at Jinan Yaoqiang International Airport by chartered flight to complete the peacekeeping mission. In addition to peacekeeping missions, the team members also donated supplies for cultural and sports activities to the resident schools; participated in the commemorat

receiving_agency: Reception and Security House for Children in Distress in Cameroon|Synergy Brotherhood of Orphans and Vulnerable Children in Cameroon
title: Chinese Consulate Donates Supplies to Orphanages in Cameroon
description: On June 2, 2016, the Chinese Consulate in Douala, Cameroon donated flour and rice sacks, vegetable oil and sugar cartons, mineral water, gas plates, plastic chairs, footwear, detergents, a television set and stationery to the orphanages Synergie Fraternite des Orphelins et Enfant Vulnerables (SYFOEV) and the Japoma-based orphanage, Maison d'accueil et de securisation des enfants en detresse (MESED). The donation benefited 54 orphans and vulnerable children._x000D_ _x000D_

title: Chinese Government donates a sea ambulance to Maldives National Defence Force
description: In 2014, during Xi Jinping's state visit to the Maldives, he pledged that the Chinese Government would donate a sea ambulance to Maldives. Then, in 2015, during the visit of President of Maldives Abdulla Yameen Abdul Gayoom to China, the Maldives and China formally agreed to gift a sea ambulance to the Maldives. The sea ambulance was handed over to the Maldives National Defence Force (MNDF) on July 12, 2018. _x000D_ _x000D_ Additionally, Chinese Ambassador to Maldives Zhang Lizhong pledged that China would provide the required technical assistance for the boat. A Chinese expert team trained th

title: Chinese Government donates second batch of anti-epidemic supplies to Moldova in March 2020 (linked to project ID#94131)
description: On March 30, 2020, the Chinese government donated the second batch of anti-epidemic supplies to Moldova. The handover ceremony was conducted at the Ministry of Health, Labor and Social Security of Moldova, and Zhang Yinghong, the Chinese Ambassador to Moldova, and Dombrevianu, the Minister of Health of Moldova, attended the event. The specific supplies are unknown, but the purpose of this donation is to help Moldova fight against the pandemic. This project is linked to project ID #94131, which details the first batch of supplies donated to Moldova from China in March 2020.
