title: Chinese Government donation of police uniforms to FSM in 2017
description: On September 15, 2017, a handover ceremony took place. During the ceremony, the Embassy handed over police uniform to the police of Pohnpei State and Kolonia Town. _x000D_

receiving_agency: Secretariat of Security and Civilian Protection of Tijuana
title: Chinese Consulate General in Tijuana, Yu Bo donates laptops to Tijuana’s Police Department in 2017
description: In 2017, the Consulate of the People’s Republic of China in Tijuana, Yu Bo donated office laptops to the Tijuana Police Department or the Secretariat of Security and Civilian Protection of Tijuana. The specific amount of laptops donated or their worth is unknown.

title: China Zhejiang Police Academy Holds Special Training Class for the Mexican police
description: In July 2017, the China Zhejiang Police Academy will hold a special training class for the Mexican police in July. On 30 June 2017, the Ambassador to Mexico went to the Chinese Embassy in Mexico to prepare the Mexican police for their travels to China for training.

title: Chinese Embassy donates reflective vests to the Mauritius Police Force
description: On July 14, 2016, the Chinese Embassy donated a batch of reflective vests to the Mauritius Police Force.

title: Chinese government donates COVID medical materials to Mauritius
description: On July 23, 2020, Chinese Ambassador Sun Gongyi and his wife Wang Ju handed over anti-epidemic materials donated by the Chinese government to the wife of the Prime Minister of Mauritius, Kobita Jagannath, on behalf of first lady Peng Liyuan. The handover ceremony took place at the treasury building in Port-Louis, the capital of Mauritius. The donated materials included medical protection gear, face masks, and body temperature scanning devices. The supplies were donated at the request of the Organization of African First Ladies for Development. The donation to Mauritius was part of a larger

receiving_agency: Mauritius Ministry of Social Security, National Solidarity and Environment and Sustainable Development
title: None
description: On and around June 5, 2018, the Chinese Government provided the Flood Control and Disaster relief techniques and management for developing countries training to the Ministry of Social Security, National Solidarity and Environment and Sustainable Development of Mauritius. Two Mauritian officials received training in this project (pg.284 of "Statement of Foreign Aid Received for the financial year 2017-2018").

title: Chinese Embassy donates office supplies to the Headquarters of the Mauritian Police
description: On August 14, 2018, the Chinese Embassy in Mauritius donated some office supplies to the Mauritius Police Headquarters, and a donation ceremony was held. The donation was in gratitude for the Mauritian Police's assistance during President Xi Jinping's visit in July. The ceremony was attended by Mauritius Police Chief Connaught and Counselor Song Yanqun. The specific materials donated and the value of the donation is unknown.

title: Chinese Government donates 12 buses to Mauritius Police Force
description: In 2005, China donated 12 seventeen-seat Huaxi buses for use by the Mauritian Police department. The value for this project is unknown.

title: Chinese Embassy donates sewing machines and other materials to the Malian Military Family Association
description: On September 20, 2019, the Chinese Embassy in Mali donated sewing machines and other materials to the Malian Military Family Association. The materials were handed over by Ambassador Zhu Liying.

receiving_agency: United Nations Multidimensional Integrated Stabilization Mission in Mali (MINUSMA)
title: Chinese Government sends peacekeeping medical workers and engineers to join the United Nations Multidimensional Integrated Stabilization Mission in Mali (Linked to Project ID#87024)
description: On December 3, 2013, the People's Liberation Army (PLA) sent 135 peacekeepers to Mali to join the United Nations Multidimensional Integrated Stabilization Mission in Mali (MINUSMA). The peacekeeping force, drawn from troops based in Harbin, China, consisted of 35 engineers, 65 medical workers, and 35 soldiers. For the soldiers involved in this peacekeeping detachment, see linked project ID#87024; the engineers and medical workers are captured by this project. The Chinese peacekeepers arrived in Bamako, Mali on December 4, 2013 for an eight-month long mission. More peacekeepers arrived later; u

title: China funds scholarships for 20 Maldivian police officers to attend seminar in China
description: On April 7, 2014, a farewell ceremony was held in Maldives for 20 officers to go to China for a seminar on police service. The program was held from April 10 to April 24.

receiving_agency: Liberian Bureau of Immigration and Naturalization|Liberian Drug Enforcement Agency|Liberian Naitonal Police (LNP)
title: Chinese Formed Police Unit Hosts Training for 27 Liberian Law Enforcement Officers (Linked to Project ID #90319)
description: From May 20 to 30, 2014, the Chinese Formed Police Unit hosted a training on law enforcement capacity building and computer operations in Sinoe County, Liberia. Twenty-seven officers from the Liberia National Police, Bureau of Immigration and Naturalization, and the Drug Enforcement Agency attended the training. Afterwards, they donated supplies to the local police force, which is captured in Project ID #90319. The Chinese Formed Police Unit were in Liberia as part of the UN Peacekeeping Mission.

title: China donates office supplies to the Malawi Ministry of Defense in 2019
description: On April 8, 2019, Ambassador Liu Hongyang met with Deputy Defense Minister Amos Melosi to exchange views on strengthening military relations between the two countries and to donate office supplies to the Ministry of Defense. China will continue to strengthen military relations through assistance, training, and cooperation to achieve new results. title: Chinese embassy donates sports equipment to Malawi Police
description: On November 17, 2008, the Chinese embassy granted sports equipment to the Malawi Police. The value of the donation is unknown.

title: Chinese embassy grants computers and 10 motorcycles to the Lilongwe Police
description: On August 2, 2010, Chinese embassy granted computers, rain jackets and 10 motorcycles to the Lilongwe Police. The value of this donation is unknown.

title: Chinese embassy donates computers to Malawi police headquarters
description: On December 7, 2011, Chinese embassy donated computers to Malawi police headquarters in Lilongwe. The value and amount of these computers is unknown.

title: Chinese government sends 20 Malawian police officers for training in China
description: From May 31, 2016 to June 29, 2016, the government of China funded 20 Malawian police officers to train at the Zhejiang Police College in China. On July 1, 2016, a welcoming ceremony was held for 20 Malawian police officers who received training in China. The cost of the training is unknown._x000D_

title: Chinese Embassy in Madagascar donates materials to Malagasy National Gendarmerie
description: On November 2, 2021, the Chinese Embassy in Madagascar donates materials to Malagasy National Gendarmerie (National Police Force of Madagascar). The donation included helmets and bulletproof vests. The monetary value of the donation is unknown.

title: Chinese Embassy donates sporting goods to Madagascar State Secretariat of the Gendarmerie
description: On February 22, 2018, Chinese Ambassador to Madagascar Yang Xiaorong, attended a ceremony commemorating the Chinese Embassy's donation of sporting goods to the State Secretariat of the Madagascar Gendarmerie. Landry Amaha Varisua, State Secretariat of the Gendarmerie of the Ministry of National Defense, and members of the Gendarmerie basketball team attended the ceremony. The donation appeared to include several basketballs, basketball shoes, and towels.

title: Chinese Embassy donates police equipment to Madagascar’s Ministry of Public Security
description: On October 19, 2017, the Chinese Ambassador to Madagascar officially donated police equipment — including bulletproof vests — to Madagascar’s Ministry of Public Security. The monetary value of this donation is unknown.

title: Chinese Government donates police supplies to Madagascar National Gendarmerie
description: On August 20, 2019, the Chinese Ambassador to Madagascar, Yang Xiaorong, presided over a ceremony officially handing over a batch of police equipment to Madagascar's National Gendarmerie. The ceremony was also presided over by General Richard Ratsimandrava, State Secretariat in charge of the National Gendarmerie. The exact nature of the donation is unknown, as is the value of the donation. The donation comes as a part of Chinese investment in crime prevention in other countries. According to the Embassy, Madagascar's Gendarmerie had previously received Chinese assistance, in the form of trai

title: Chinese Government dispatch 11 optometry experts to support the Light Action Campaign (Linked to Project ID#60023)
description: On September 19, 2017, a memorandum of understanding (MOU) for the 'Light Action Campaign' campaign was signed by Chinese Ambassador to Madagascar Yang Xiaorong and Malagasy Minister of Public Health Lalatiana Andriamanarivo. As part of the 2 week long program, 11 Chinese optometry experts were sent to the Antananarivo on May 31, 2017 to provide free cataract treatments to Malagasy patients. The goal of the campaign was to provide 200 free surgeries. Additionally, the medical equipment of the experts use was left at Joseph Ravoahangy Andrianavalona Hospital (see Project ID #60023). Because the

title: Chinese Formed Police Unit Donate Sporting and Security Equipment to Sinoe County Police ( Linked to Project ID #90318)
description: On May 30, 2014, the Chinese Formed Police Unit donated sporting goods and security equipment to the Sinoe County Police. This donation was made at the end of a law enforcement training run by the Chinese Formed Police Unit, which is captured in Project ID #90318. The monetary value of the donation is unknown.

title: China donates humanitarian aid supplies to Iraq in January 2021
description: On January 21, 2021, China delivered humanitarian aid supplies to Iraq. This donation included ambulances, mobile generators, and office equipment such as computers. Ambassador Zhang Tao and Vice Chair of Iraqi Ministry of Domestic Affairs attended the handover ceremony. The purpose of this donation is to help Iraq improve its ability to fight the epidemic, maintain its public security, and provide public services.

funder: Provincial Government of the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region
title: China donates COVID-related supplies to Iraq in April 2020
description: On April 22nd, 2020, the government of Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region donated a batch of medical supplies to the Iraqi Ministry of Defense. The handover ceremony held that day was attended by Chinese Ambassador to Iraq and senior officials in the Iraqi Ministry of Defense. This is the third batch of the medical donations from China to Iraq.

title: Indonesia receives Chinese support for their maritime security
description: On 6 October 2014 China signed an agreement to send remote sensing data to Indonesia remote sensing satellite ground stations to help the country update the stations and improve its maritime law enforcement and disaster prevention mitigation. The two collaborating agencies include the Indonesian Maritime Security Coordination Board and the China National Space Administration. _x000D_ _x000D_

title: China hosts 15 law enforcement officers from Cote d’Ivoire for training
description: On June 13, 2018, Ambassador Tang Weibin in Côte d’Ivoire held a farewell reception at the embassy for the study and training of 15 law enforcement officers in China. Director of the Office of the Ministry of the Interior, Chief of Police, Director of the Department of International Cooperation of the Ministry of Culture, and Acting Director of the Department of Asia-Pacific Affairs of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs attended the reception. The program length and value are not known.

The value of this donation is unknown. China also donated 3 million USD to Congo following the blast (#30708).

The specific walkie-talkie model was the TC-700 Professional Walkie-Talkie (also known as the Hytera TC-700 Professional Two-way Radio).
